Finally, the rationality and effectiveness of the heterogeneous load cooperative control method are verified through simulation example analysis.

articleTitle: A Health Prediction Method for Electrochemical Energy Storage Systems Based on the BP-Adaboost Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The prediction and timely identification of the health status of electrochemical energy storage (EES) systems is of great importance to the prompt formulation of precautions and the prevention of potential failures. In light of the characteristics of EES systems, the research proposes a health prediction method for these systems based on the BP-Adaboost model, which can identify key parameters affecting the health status of EES systems. The technique relies on the back propagation (BP) neural network algorithm and the adaptive boosting (AdaBoost) algorithm to construct a strong predictor comprising multiple weak predictors derived from the BP neural network, aiming to predicate the health status of EES systems. The simulation experiments show that the strong predictor developed based on the BP_Adaboost model has notably lower prediction errors compared to the weak predictors, demonstrating superior predictive performance.

articleTitle: Empirical Analysis of the Benefits of Intelligent Mobile Recharging Solution for Port Horizontal Transportation Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper empirically assesses the Intelligent Mobile Recharging Solution (IMRS) for port horizontal transportation vehicles, comparing its operational efficiency and cost-effectiveness to traditional recharging methods. The IMRS, which uses Mobile Charging Cars (MCCs) to recharge vehicles during idle periods, improves operational continuity and reduces infrastructure costs. The study outlines operational parameters, cost estimations, and simulation outcomes, showing that the IMRS can achieve over a one-third cost reduction due to smaller battery requirements and a streamlined recharging process. Simulations in 2D and 3D environments confirm the IMRS's ability to support continuous 24-hour operations, while also highlighting the need for further research in real-world validation, operational schedule optimization, and consideration of nonlinear factors.

articleTitle: Ultra-short-term forecasting method of demand-side resource response transaction scale based on GAT-Transformer
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the transformation from "source-load interaction" to "source-load interaction," demand-side resources can improve the flexibility of power grid and promote the efficient use of clean energy by participating in power grid regulation. Due to the wide variety and different characteristics of demand side resources, the management of demand side is becoming more and more important. The accuracy of demand side resource transaction scale measurement is one of the keys to improve the resilience of power grid. In order to solve this problem, this study proposes an ultra-short-term forecasting method of demand-side resource response transaction scale based on GAT-Transformer. Firstly, the demand side resource transaction data and meteorological data are input into the GAT network, and the graph feature representation is extracted. Secondly, the feature representation is enhanced by combining category labeling and location embedding, and the dropout operation is applied to reduce the risk of overfitting. Finally, the Transformer module is used to further process the enhanced features, and the Multi-Layer Perceptron ( MLP ) is used to classify and output the final results. The experimental results show that compared with other prediction methods, the prediction results of this method are at least 0.232 lower in RMSE, 0.247 lower in MAE and 5.702 lower in MAPE.

articleTitle: Approach of Black Start Scenario for Photovoltaic-Storage-Charging-Discharging Station Based on Source-Network-Load-Storage System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The Inverters based on source-network-load-storage, that can be classified into Grid Following (GFL) inverters and Grid Forming (GFM) inverters. In GFL mode, the voltage and frequency are regulated by the grid and therefore operate as grid-connected inverters. In GFM mode, one or several of the inverters should be used as voltage and/or frequency regulators to form the local grid. It is called vehicle to line (V2L) charging network When vehicle to grid operates in GFM mode. In this paper, approach of black start scenario for photovoltaic-storage-charging-discharging integrated energy station based on source-network-load-storage is discussed and put forward. The developed charging network consists of photovoltaic panels and GFM photovoltaic inverter, GFM V2L inverter, GFM storage inverter, energy storage system, general loads and key loads. GFM inverters operate in charging network mode to supply power to the grid, which realizing uninterrupted power supply or black-start power supply to key loads. And the charging network improve the reliability of power supply in the site of State Grid, Beijing Chaoyang Electric Power Supply Company.

articleTitle: Measurement and Co-optimisation Model of Electricity Carbon Emission Factors Considering Time-Series Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Urbanisation and rising living standards have led to rising electricity demand, posing challenges to the balance between supply and demand of the power system and environmental sustainability. The aim of this paper is to propose a time-series characteristic-based model for measuring and co-optimising the carbon emission factors of electricity in order to improve energy efficiency and reduce carbon emissions through an in-depth analysis of the electricity consumption characteristics of urban residents. The study first explores the time-series characteristics of residents' electricity consumption behaviour and its influencing factors, and then constructs a Bayesian network model to analyse the time-series state of electricity loads. On this basis, the paper further develops an electricity consumption optimisation model considering carbon emission factors, and verifies the effectiveness of the model with actual data. The results show that the model can effectively reduce the carbon emission of residential electricity consumption and lower the cost of electricity consumption, which provides a new perspective and strategy for the low-carbon operation and load management of the power system, and has important practical application value and theoretical significance.

articleTitle: Fire Source Identification and Maximum Temperature Variation Analysis in Ventilated Cable Tunnels
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The current body of research, both domestic and international, indicates a focus on critical wind speeds, smoke recirculation lengths and temperature field variations in ventilated cable tunnel fires. Nevertheless, research on the identification of fire sources in ventilated conditions remains limited. The influence of wind speeds on the location of the fire source within cable tunnels renders traditional fire-sourcing methods ineffective. It is of great importance to gain an understanding of the positional shift of fire sources under varying wind speeds and the changes in maximum temperatures within ventilated tunnels. This paper employs numerical simulation to evaluate the influence of wind speed on fire development within cable tunnels. A comprehensive simulation model was constructed, and experiments were conducted under diverse ventilation speeds. The findings illustrate a pronounced correlation between wind speed and fire source location shift, and maximum temperature trends were distinctly identified. A model was developed to validate the relationship between fire source displacement and maximum temperature, providing theoretical support to enhance fire detection and safety under ventilated conditions.

articleTitle: Low-carbon Optimal Energy Management of Integrated Electricity-Natural Gas Systems Considering Uncertainties
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As global warming becomes increasingly severe, Integrated energy systems play an important role in carbon peaking and carbon neutrality goals. On the one hand, it can improve the security and reliability of energy supply through multi-energy complementary, on the other hand, it can also improve energy utilization efficiency and reduce carbon emissions through energy conversion at the same time. So, we propose a low-carbon scheduling model for the integrated electricity-natural gas energy systems that take into account the uncertainty output of renewable energy and demand response. Firstly, we construct the framework of the systems considering asynchronous mechanism, the second-order cone relaxation method is used for the non-convex network topology constraints, Secondly, demand response consisting curtailable loads and transferrable loads are introduced to the integrated systems. Finally, distributionally robust chance constraint model is used to solve the renewable energy output uncertainty problems. Case study shows the calculation efficiency of the second-order cone relaxation method is improved by 78.9% compared with the traditional segmental linearization, and the higher proportion of transferable loads, the lower carbon emissions and cost of the whole systems, finally, the balance of safety, economy and low-carbon of the system can be achieved when the risk tolerance factor about 0.1.

articleTitle: Model Design of Distributed Energy Aggregation Participating in Green Electricity Trading
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper mainly introduces the mode of distributed new energy participating in green electricity trading by aggregation. Firstly, it introduces the feasibility of this mode, secondly, it introduces the current green electricity trading mode, analyzes the two major difficulties of distributed new energy aggregation participating in green electricity, and introduces the transfer process of green certificates under this mode. Finally, the aggregation mode of distributed new energy is designed, and the mechanism of distributed new energy to participate in green electricity trading in the form of package is designed.

articleTitle: Optimal Scheduling of Thermal Power Plants Considering Demand Response and Carbon Capture
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to cope with the impact of carbon dioxide on the environment, this paper proposes an optimal scheduling model of thermal power plants considering demand response and carbon capture technology. Firstly, a demand response model is established to optimize the load management of the power system through electrothermally stimulated demand response. The electric heating load curve optimized by the electric and thermal excitation demand response coordination scheduling model is obtained. The principle of carbon capture is briefly described and the mathematical model of carbon capture thermal power plants is constructed. Next, taking the minimum operating cost of thermal power plants as the objective function, and considering the power balance, thermal power unit operation constraints, carbon capture equipment constraints and heat storage equipment constraints, the optimal scheduling model of thermal power plants with demand response and carbon capture is constructed to seek the optimal relationship between carbon emissions and electric heating load, so as to ensure the low-carbon economic operation of thermal power plants. Finally, the simulation results show that the model considering demand response and carbon capture has obvious advantages in reducing operating costs and reducing carbon emissions.

articleTitle: A Renewable Energy Generation Power Forecasting Method Based on Double Attention Mechanism-Long Short-Term Memory
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Due to the intermittence and fluctuation of renewable energy generation, the accurate power forecasting of renewable energy generation is crucial for the stability and security of power grid operations. However, existing power forecasting methods are not sufficient for information extraction in historical data, which will reduce the power forecasting accuracy. Therefore, this paper proposes a renewable energy generation power forecasting method based on double attention mechanism-long short-term memory (LSTM), which adopts the self-attention mechanism to extract the key information of the time dimension and the attention mechanism to extract the key information of the variable dimension. By fusing the extracted time and variable dimension features with the current moment hidden layer vector, the input data features can be more fully extracted. Finally, the forecasting results of photovoltaic (PV) and wind power generation are given to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Lithium Plating Diagnosis of Lithium-ion Batteries Based on Clustering with Multidimensional Features
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As one of the primary energy storage devices today, lithium-ion batteries (LIBs) play a crucial role across various industries. However, lithium plating on the anode of LIBs significantly impacts their lifespan and safety, posing a substantial challenge to the further development of this technology. To address this issue, this paper proposes a lithium plating diagnostic method for LIBs based on multidimensional feature extraction and clustering analysis. By extracting high-precision battery model features and incremental capacity curve features, and developing a density-based clustering algorithm optimized by particle swarm optimization, a method for diagnosing lithium plating faults in LIBs is introduced. The accuracy of this method is then validated by capacity degradation rates and post-mortem analysis. The results indicate that lithium plating diagnosis based on multidimensional features is more accurate than diagnosis based on single-dimensional features, with a 10% improvement in lithium plating detection rate.

articleTitle: Voltage Estimation-Based Mobile Energy Storage Scheduling Method for Distribution System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As electricity demand in distribution networks (DN) continues to rise, integrating renewable energy poses stability challenges due to its inherent uncertainty. Although forecasting techniques can predict network load and renewable energy output, relying solely on these techniques may lead to operational instability due to forecast errors. This paper proposes a mobile energy storage (MES) scheduling method to address this problem. First, the voltage fluctuation limits at each node in the DN are calculated based on a voltage interval estimation model, thereby identifying the nodes where MESs can provide auxiliary services. Thereafter, the rolling time-domain optimization technique is applied for periodically adapting MES routes to minimize their travel costs and fuel costs simultaneously. Simulation results show that this method reduces average voltage deviations, lowers operational costs, and allows MESs to maintain optimal SOC levels, ensuring quick demand response and minimal idle time.

articleTitle: Identifying Differentiated User Preferences for Spatial Flexibility Assessment of Fast Charging Station Loads
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The spatial flexibility of fast-charging station (FCS) loads refers to the potential to redistribute these loads by influencing users’ FCS selections via incentives. Such spatial flexibility can benefit power systems by alleviating congestion and promoting renewable energy integration. Since user preferences directly influence FCS selections, they play a key role in assessing the spatial flexibility of FCS loads. From the perspective of charging station operators (CSOs), this paper aims to identify user preferences using real-world data (station, user, and order data) and a data-driven discrete choice model. The target is to identify differentiated user preferences across various influencing attributes (charging price, charging power, station facilities, and surrounding points of interest), and differences between private and commercial electric vehicles (EVs). Case studies validate the proposed approach for identifying user preferences, with the accuracy of predicting FCS selections exceeding 80%. These insights provide a foundation for CSOs to effectively utilize EV spatial flexibility through price incentives.

articleTitle: Connotation and Functional Analysis of Integrated Energy Generation and Consumption Unit IECU
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to cope with the challenges of global climate change and accelerate the low-carbon transformation of the energy and power system, Academician Zhou Xiaoxin put forward the idea of a multi-energy complementary integrated energy system development model, i.e., the establishment of an integrated energy production unit (IEPU) and an integrated energy consumption unit (IECU) for the source energy production bases and the end-consumption areas, respectively. This paper focuses on the conceptual connotation and functional model of IECU. First, the conceptual development of IECU is clarified based on the existing literature. Then, the core connotation and composition structure of IECU are elaborated in detail. Finally, based on the functional analysis method in TRIZ theory, the components of IECU are derived, and the interactions of the components within the IECU unit are analyzed to summarize the functions of IECU. The research in this paper expects to provide a reference meaning for the construction and development of IECU.

articleTitle: Prediction of the Thyristor Failure Rate under Various Operating Conditions Due to Atmospheric Neutron Irradiation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Atmospheric neutron irradiation is a threat to the safe and stable operation of DC transmission systems. In this paper, the failure rate of 8.5 kV thyristors due to atmospheric neutron irradiation is predicted using the ±800 kV DC transmission system as an example. Firstly, the voltage stress applied to the thyristors in the converter valve of the Ultra-High Voltage Direct Current (UHVDC) transmission system under various operating conditions is calculated. Then, the failure rate due to atmospheric neutron irradiation is predicted by integrating the periodic voltage waveform and the neutron irradiation failure rate under different voltage stresses. This study is of great significance for the construction of the UHVDC transmission project and the protection of high-voltage power semiconductors against the irradiation effect.

articleTitle: Research on DC Fault Clearing Strategy Based on MMC Sub-module Transmission System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: When the DC fault clearing technology of the MMC converter valve is adopted, the system does not need to configure expensive DC circuit breakers on the DC side, and it is economical. It does not need to operate AC circuit breakers. When a short circuit occurs on the DC side, the MMC's blocking function with DC fault-clearing ability can be used to quickly clear the faults. Based on the existing DC fault-clearing technology of the MMC converter valve, this paper aims to propose a DC fault-clearing and system recovery strategy for hybrid MMC.

articleTitle: Risk Assessment Method for Renewable Energy Uncertainty Considering Energy Storage and Automatic Generation Control
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increasing penetration of renewable energy in the power system, the low inertia and uncertainty of its output power pose new challenges to the security and reliability of the system. In this paper, we propose a risk assessment method for renewable energy uncertainty considering energy storage and automatic generator control, and analyze the power fluctuation of renewable power sources in the IEEE system models. The overall risk probability of the system is calculated by setting different upper limits of branch power transmission and sampling the amount of power fluctuation of the distributed power source using the ALOE (At Least One rare Event) method and the CMCS (Conventional Monte Carlo Sampling) method, respectively. The results show that the ALOE method can effectively capture rare events, and the standard deviation of its calculated risk probability is smaller than that of the CMCS, which leads to a more accurate assessment of system risk. This study provides a more effective risk assessment tool for power systems containing renewable energy sources.

articleTitle: Regional Autonomous Optimization Scheduling of Active Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With a high percentage of new energy sources connected to the grid, existing centralized control methods have limitations in scheduling and data interaction, and cannot effectively meet the demand for distributed energy consumption and the economic goals of the distribution network. This paper proposes an active distribution network optimization method that effectively integrates global centralized optimization and regional decentralized autonomy. By considering loads, distributed power sources and energy storage systems as distributed resources, constructing a framework of ADN management body-regional regulation point-distributed resource unit, introducing an objective cascade algorithm to decouple multi-objective shared variables, and establishing a regional autonomous optimization model based on ATC in order to optimize the overall economic objective of the distribution network and improve the overall system performance.

articleTitle: Virtual synchronous generator control strategy for railway power conditioner with integrated renewable energy
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The electrified railway flexible traction power supply system integrating renewable energy sources such as photovoltaic and energy storage can give full play to the advantages of multiple energy complementarities, improve the absorption rate of renewable energy, reduce fossil energy pollution, reduce the power supply burden of the railway traction power grid, and further reduce the three-phase imbalance of the traction power grid, and improve the power quality. However, in the case of a weak power grid, if the railway power conditioner (RPC) still adopts the traditional grid-following control strategy, the system will inevitably be unstable due to the loss of the phase-locked loop. Due to the complexity of parameter design and the limitations of application scenarios, the traditional phase-locked loop improvement scheme cannot significantly improve the phase-locked effect. To improve the stability of railway power conditioner under weak grid conditions, a railway power conditioner control strategy based on Virtual Synchronous Generator (VSG) was proposed. To test the effectiveness of the management strategy, a simulation model was built in Matlab/Simulink. The simulation results show that the proposed control strategy has a better compensation for the effects of power and voltage control.

articleTitle: An Active Battery Balancing Strategy for Battery Packs in Series
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Battery packs are widely used for electric vehicles. However, Battery packs connected in series suffer from weak consistency, reducing available capacity and creating safety issues. The Battery Management System (BMS) is used to address these problems. For the BMS, the paper proposes an active balancing circuit with a fuzzy logic based balancing strategy for series connected battery packs. The simulation results show that the strategy realizes SOC consistency and improves power utilization.

articleTitle: Research on Electromechanical Intelligent Construction of Multi-fusion Hydropower Station Based on BIM Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The installation of electromechanical equipment is the key to hydropower station construction. The installation of electromechanical equipment in hydropower station is difficult and requires high precision; the installation process involves many professional fields and multi-party personnel, the business process is complicated and cumbersome, and the construction schedule and quality control are difficult; the whole life management period of equipment circulation is long, the task is heavy and the cost is high. So, this paper proposes for the first time an intelligent control scheme for electromechanical construction of hydropower station, which runs building information modeling (BIM) technology through the whole life cycle of the project and creates a new management and control mode for project construction.

articleTitle: Bus Voltage Control in DC Microgrids Based on Hybrid Energy Storage Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes an improved droop control based on the state of charge (SOC) power exponent for a hybrid energy storage system (HESS). This method addresses poor current balance and voltage deviations. A photovoltaic-storage DC microgrid simulation model is constructed on the MATLAB/Simulink platform to evaluate the voltage stability of the DC microgrid. The simulation results demonstrate the superior performance of the improved SOC power exponent droop control method.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study on Pumped Storage Efficiency under Different Stakeholder Objectives for Balancing Renewable Energy Fluctuations and Curtailment
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: While Pumped storage can effectively cope with the increasing demand for regulation flexibility from both the power sources and power grids, the impact of the dispatch demand from different stakeholders on the round-trip efficiency of pumped storage is unclear. Based on the difference between variable renewable energy (VRE) power generation and grid demand for stability, this work sets different scheduling objectives for the hybrid operation of pumped storage and VRE. Then, a short-term optimal scheduling model was established to analyzes the round-trip efficiency of pumped storage power plant under two objective functions. The results show that: (1) The round-trip efficiency decreases 1.49% when it promotes VRE consumption by 0.96% under the high demand for VRE consumption over 95%. (2) The daily generation of pumped storage increases by 1.16% when it reduces the VRE fluctuations, which also reduces the grid-connected power of VRE by 1%. This study highlights the need for careful consideration of the trade-offs between grid stability and VRE utilization efficiency to ensure sustainable and reliable power system operations.

articleTitle: Small-Signal Modeling and Analysis of Offshore Wind-Farms-Side MMC Based on Linear Time-Periodic Theory
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Electromagnetic oscillations pose a threat to the operation of wind-farms-side modular multilevel converter (MMC). However, the internal dynamics of offshore wind-farms-side MMC make the linear time-invariant (LTI) modeling no longer suitable for dynamics analysis. Therefore, the linear time-periodic (LTP) theory is applied in this paper. The small-signal model considering the time-varying characteristics of offshore wind-farms-side MMC is established using trajectory linearization. Then, its small-signal stability is analyzed based on LTP eigenvalue. In addition to the general current control, the influences of specific voltage and frequency (V-f) control on electromagnetic oscillations are further revealed. Finally, the effectiveness of the above analysis is verified in comparison with the nonlinear model.

articleTitle: Emergency Control Strategy for Voltage Stability of Receiving-end Grid Considering the Coordination of Multi-type Resource
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes a voltage stability emergency control strategy to coordinate multiple types of regulation resources including grid-forming energy storage, synchronous condenser, and loads. Firstly, a voltage stability prediction model is established based on SE module and CNN, and the mapping of control quantity and voltage stability level is revealed. Secondly, the reactive power regulation characteristics of multiple resources is analyzed, and the improvement effect of various control resources on voltage stability level is evaluated based on control sensitivity index. Finally, an emergency control coordination strategy for power grid voltage stability is proposed. The power regulation characteristics of grid-forming energy storage module were analyzed in PSASP, and the validity of the proposed approach was demonstrated in the test system with voltage instability issues.

articleTitle: AoI-aware Adaptive Learning Empowered Resource Allocation for Multispectral Corona Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Multispectral detection is an effective method for corona detection by combining visible light and ultraviolet images. The detection process requires ensuring the timeliness of image data, measured by age of information (AoI). However, the traditional resource allocation method is hard to provide long-term AoI guarantee. Therefore, we proposed a joint optimization algorithm based on AoI-aware adaptive learning to minimize AoI. Simulation results confirm its effectiveness in AoI minimization.

articleTitle: Location, Sizing, and Scheduling Optimization Model for Distributed Energy Storage under Demand Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As renewable energy penetration increases, load forecasting errors challenge system operators to balance variable supply and demand, To address this challenge, this paper proposes a two-stage optimization model for distributed energy storage (DES)planning under demand uncertainty. The proposed model first optimizes DES site locations and capacities based on cost factors like infrastructure costs and emissions impacts, The second stage then minimizes electricity procurement costs through optimal daily operational scheduling for each DES station, This includes balancing energy transfers to manage peak loads and fulfilling unpredictable demand across the distribution grid, By formulating the problem using mixed. integer nonlinear programming and a heuristic algorithm, the model can strategically plan DES investments despite load forecast uncertainties, Simulation results using real energy storage data demonstrate the model's effectiveness in determining robust DES deployments, This leads to reductions in long-term operational costs while improving renewable energy integration and distribution grid flexibility.

articleTitle: Stability Control of Photovoltaic Power Generation System Through Virtual Resistance Fitting Under Variable Irradiation Conditions
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The oscillation suppression strategy for PV grid-connected systems (PVGS) designed under specific operating conditions may not adapt well to variable irradiation conditions. A virtual resistance fitting-based stability control strategy is proposed in this paper. The proposed strategy first fitted the desired virtual resistance function of the PV converter under variable irradiation conditions, and then introduced the virtual resistance by using a band-pass filter and current feedback to counteract the negative resistance effect. The proposed strategy is simple in design and effectively enhances the stability of the system under variable illumination conditions without affecting the steady-state output.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Grid Impedance Estimation Methods for Online Stability Control of Renewable Energy
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the field of grid connected converter (GCC) stability analysis, there are several problems with grid impedance estimation. Firstly, due to time variant of grid network, traditional offline grid impedance measurement can no longer meet the adaptive control of GCC. Second, the traditional frequency sweeping method takes a long time, and the impedance obtained is in the frequency domain. If the realistic values of the inductance and resistance of the grid impedance can be directly obtained, it will be more convenient for evaluating the stability of the converter network system. Lastly, when injecting multi sine disturbances into the grid through converter, the disturbance peak may be large after the superposition of multiple harmonics, and the GCC may have problems such as overmodulation and harmonic pollution. Therefore, how to quickly and accurately measure grid impedance is the primary problem that needs to be solved in converter system stability analysis.

articleTitle: Research on the fault characteristics of the generator motor during the self starting process of the variable speed pumped storage unit under pumping conditions and its adaptability to relay protection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Variable speed pumped storage adjusts the power generation or pumping by changing the speed of the unit, thereby achieving rapid response and power balance to the power grid. The variable speed pumped storage unit utilizes its own excitation system and control strategy to achieve the start-up of pumping conditions. The electrical characteristics of the stator and rotor during the start-up process are different from those of conventional fixed speed pumped storage units, and no in-depth research has been conducted yet. This article studies the rotor fault characteristics during the self starting process of variable speed pumped storage units under pumping conditions, and conducts simulation in PSCAD. Through adaptability research on the relay protection of conventional pumped storage units and doubly fed fans, specialized rotor protection needs to be configured during the self starting process.

articleTitle: Calculation and Evaluation Method of Adjustable Capacity of Virtual Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As a special logical entity of power plants participating in the power market and power grid operation, virtual power plants have different adjustable performance from conventional power units. Since virtual power plants contain a large amount of renewable energy, their output volatility leads to uncertainty in the output of virtual power plants, which makes it difficult for virtual power plants to reach the level of traditional power plants in terms of execution of dispatch instructions. Therefore, based on the characteristics of virtual power plants, this paper constructs a series of indicators to evaluate the adjustable performance of virtual power plants to measure the regulation effect. Combined with the functions of virtual power plants themselves, adjustable performance indicators and evaluation methods are constructed from three aspects: reliability, dispatch-ability and internal resources. Finally, the AHP-entropy weight method combined evaluation method is used through examples to obtain the overall adjustable capacity calculation results through calculation, which is helpful for the analysis and evaluation of the adjustable capacity of virtual power plants.

articleTitle: Carbon Emission Accounting for Integrated Energy Systems Considering Network Interconnection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Integrated energy system (IES) combines three types of energy, namely electricity, gas and heat, which can effectively improve the utilization of energy and realize the energy complementarity between different energy systems. The operation mode of the integrated energy system is complex, and various energy sources are converted to each other, resulting in the carbon emissions generated by different energy sources coupled with the energy flow. It is of great significance to clarify the distribution of carbon emission flows in the integrated energy system for the operation optimization of low-carbon integrated energy system. Based on the carbon emission flow theory and power flow tracing theory, this paper proposes a simplified carbon emission flow model for integrated energy system, and analyzes the carbon emission intensity of each node of the integrated energy system through matrix operation. Specifically, firstly, the carbon emission flow model of three energy systems converted into a network is established. Secondly, a calculation model of carbon emission flow for unified integrated energy system is proposed through matrix operation. Finally, based on the integrated energy testing system, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified.

articleTitle: A Reactive Power Control Method for the PCC of Wind Farm with System-Side Participation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In large-scale wind power aggregation areas, the significant variations in wind speed often result in the reactive power regulation equipment within wind farms reaching their operational limits prematurely during daily operations, causing substantial voltage fluctuations at the point of common coupling (PCC). To address this issue, nearby substations must provide reactive power support to the wind farm’s PCC. However, due to the complexity of the power grid, the reactive power support from substations cannot fully flow to the wind farm. To this end, this paper introduces a reactive power support control method, including the theoretical analysis for the shunt of reactive power flow based on the shunt ratio and an optimal selection method for substations participating in voltage regulation, as well as an optimization model to determine the reactive power allocation for each compensating substation. The proposed method is validated on the IEEE 39-bus system, and the results show that the compensating substations successfully achieved the desired control effect for the wind farms’ PCC.

articleTitle: A Two-Tier Analysis Method for Adjustable Potential of Building Electricity Use Based on Electricity Consumption Data
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid development of new power systems, it is urgent to deeply explore the characteristics of building load ontology and the influence of electricity consumption behavior factors on the adjustable potential. Based on the collected electricity consumption data, this paper proposes a two-layer analysis method for the potential of electricity consumption adjustment. Firstly, the density clustering algorithm (DBSCAN) was used to classify the load ontology characteristics by three key indicators: load rate, daily peak-to-valley difference and peak-to-valley difference rate. Secondly, principal component analysis (PCA) was used to reduce the dimensionality of building electricity consumption behavior factors to improve the speed and accuracy of clustering, and then the degree of dispersion is clustered by Fuzzy C-Means (FCM) to analyze the user's adjustable potential. Finally, the effectiveness and practicability of the DBSCAN-PCA-FCM two-layer method proposed in this paper are verified by using the measured building electricity consumption data and the influencing factors of building electricity consumption behavior in eastern China, which can provide a theoretical basis for users to participate in demand-side response.

articleTitle: Offshore wind Power Output Prediction Method Based on Bi-LSTM and Time Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As an important source of renewable energy, offshore wind power has been widely concerned and developed rapidly in recent years. Given that offshore wind power shows strong randomness and volatility, accurate prediction of offshore wind power output is of crucial importance for promoting the effective integration of renewable energy and the existing power grid. Aiming at the problem of unstable prediction of offshore wind power output, this paper proposes a hybrid framework based on Bi-LSTM (Bi-directional Long Short-Term Memory) and time attention mechanism. Firstly, it is necessary to normalize the historical data of offshore wind power. The Bi-directional Long Short-Term Memory (Bi-LSTM) model is used to capture the correlation between the data before and after, and the complex dynamic characteristics in the time series data of offshore wind power are modeled and analyzed. Secondly, the wind power output data is decomposed by STL (Seasonal-Trend Decomposition using Loess) to obtain the wind power output trend, and the trend part data is modeled by Bi-LSTM. Then, the MLP (Multilayer Perceptron) model is used to extract the external factors (such as weather, market fluctuations, etc.) that affect the offshore wind power output; Finally, the processed offshore wind power output, wind power output trend and external influencing factor data are fused to obtain the prediction results. Compared with other prediction methods, the prediction results of the method in this paper have at least a reduction of 1.2460 in root mean square error (RMSE), at least a reduction of 0.6002 in mean absolute error (MAE), and at least an increase of 0.0134 in the coefficient of determination R2.

articleTitle: Design of Low-speed High Torque Permanent Magnet Direct Drive Motor
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: China has the worlds first coal mining volume, coal energy mining is the top priority of Chinese industry. Improving the efficiency of coal mining and ensuring the stable operation of coal mining equipment is the main direction of the development of coal mining industry. Current mining motor body and frequency converter are using the arrangement of separation, between the power supply cable in the work will be distributed inductance and capacitor, when high frequency signal through, the motor end voltage will rise, affect the insulation life of the motor, in order to alleviate the pressure of the motor insulation end, need to increase the protection of the insulation structure to deal with the increased voltage, and need to be in a reasonable range to reduce the distance between the motor and frequency converter, avoid the insulation structure damage. This paper designed a inverter and motor, according to the rotor structure of the permanent magnet direct drive motor FEM model, no-load anti-potential curve and motor load parameter curve, the motor operation standard, verify the correctness of the mining permanent magnet direct drive machine design.

articleTitle: The Bidding Strategy of Virtual Power Plant Considering the Uncertainty of the Flexible Loads
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper presents a novel bidding strategy for virtual power plants considering the uncertainty associated with flexible loads. The proposed method incorporates a profit allocation mechanism and strategically excludes highly uncertain loads from bidding. The problem is formulated as a mixed-integer linear programming model. Simulations demonstrate that this approach outperforms traditional stochastic optimization methods in managing risks associated with uncertain flexible loads.

articleTitle: Typical Scenario Selection for Energy Storage Planning from Annual-Horizon Operation of A Large- Scale Power System with Renewable Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With long-duration energy storage technologies evolve, the cycling period of energy storage is no longer limited to a single day. The cross-day operation of energy storage engages in the regulation of renewable energy on longer time scales. Traditional methods for extracting typical days based on renewable energy output or the net load of the entire network have not adequately accounted for the operational modes and the flexibility of energy storages and units. In this study, a method for identifying typical days is employed, which utilizes optimal operational outcomes as the data foundation, thereby taking into account the operational characteristics of renewable energy, energy storage, and conventional units within the system. A machine learning approach combining supervised and unsupervised techniques is applied to extract a set of typical days that capture system operational features. This methodology has been validated within a 38-node network with high renewable penetration.

articleTitle: A Dynamic Business Model for Battery Swapping Stations with Pricing and Charging Scheduling
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To mitigate carbon emissions and achieve carbon neutrality, developing electric vehicles (EVs) has proven to be an effective strategy. Battery swapping stations (BSSs) are emerging as efficient facilities for replenishing EV batteries. While existing research has predominantly concentrated on scheduling problems related to battery charging within BSSs, there remains a notable gap in developing effective models for pricing as well as scheduling battery swaps. In this study, we investigate the pricing mechanisms of a single BSS operating within a system where the power grid engages in electricity trading, subject to load constraints and dynamic, price-sensitive swapping demand. By employing a deep reinforcement learning approach within a Markov Decision Process framework, we aim to optimize real-time battery charging, discharging, and pricing decisions, which can enhance the overall profit of the BSS compared to fixed-price models while balancing the charging demand.

articleTitle: A Distributed Adjustable Resource Credit Risk Evaluation Model Based on Behavior-Credit-Risk Transmission Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Based on the construction of the credit risk system in the electricity market, this paper proposes a credit risk evaluation model that considers distributed adjustable resources such as conventional generators, energy storage operators, controllable loads, and electric vehicles. Firstly, a market entity credit rating index system and method that takes into account transaction behaviors are constructed. Secondly, the traditional credit metrics model is specifically improved to build a credit risk evaluation model suitable for multiple entities in the electricity market. Finally, through case study analysis, the credit risk value is quantitatively measured, and key influencing factors are studied through sensitivity analysis, verifying the effectiveness of the model.

articleTitle: A Mixed Four-Port Renewable Energy Converter based on Power Component Sharing
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This article presents a new four-port power converter that mixes two boost converters with a phase-shifted-full-bridge converter. Two multiplexing arms are utilized in the structure to perform the function of phase-shifted-full-bridge, and at the same time, each arm with three power switches can be used to handle a boost converter, which can adjust the voltage conversion ratio between a PV and the battery. Therefore, the cost can be reduced, and the system can handle two groups of photovoltaic (PV) with one group of battery by using only six power switches.

articleTitle: Low-Carbon Collaborative Optimization of Agricultural Park Based on Carbon Emission Flow
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The integrated energy system of the agricultural park includes energy hubs and typical users such as greenhouse. To achieve low-carbon management of the park, this paper introduces carbon emission flow into the agricultural park. The operators of the park, aiming at low carbon and economy, purchase electricity from distribution and dispatch energy equipment to meet the energy demands of users. The user side updates the energy demand according to the low carbon demand response of the price, and the operator and the user side iterate up and down until the equilibrium. The example verifies the low carbon benefit of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Load Restoration of Distribution Network with Solar-Storage-Charging Stations Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Power system outages, particularly those caused by extreme weather, are becoming increasingly frequent and result in substantial economic and social costs. Rapid restoration of power services following a blackout is essential to enhance power system resilience. To address the issue of load restoration following extreme disasters, distributed resources can be used as emergency backups. With the increasing number of electric vehicles (EVs), charging station becomes a critical coupling node in the distribution network. Thus, a load restoration strategy based on solar-storage-charging (SSC) stations scheduling strategy is proposed in this paper. Firstly, photovoltaic (PV), energy storage system (ESS), and EV charging characteristics in SSC stations are modeled under extreme conditions. Then the collaborative load restoration strategy is established based on the branch flow model (BFM) in the distribution network. Finally, a mathematical optimization framework is constructed, and a tractable solution can be obtained. The results demonstrate that the proposed strategy effectively leverages the flexibility of EV energy, coordinating the decision-making of SSC stations and other DGs under emergency, thereby enhancing the restoration of critical loads to some extent.

articleTitle: Design of coal quantity measurement system based on laser scanning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to save the production cost and improve the efficiency of thermal power plants, it is necessary to optimize the design of coal quantity measurement system. In this paper, the measurement of coal quantity by laser scanning is proposed. This method has the advantages of accuracy, high efficiency and easy operation. The research contents include: using the laser scanner to obtain the surface data of the coal pile, integrating the three-dimensional coordinate information, selecting the most suitable laser scanner, studying the hardware design and data realization, analyzing the data transmission and studying the error in the volume calculation of the coal pile. The system can save costs and has good use value.

articleTitle: Automatic Topology Identification Technology for Distribution Systems Based on the Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the construction of smart grids, traditional distribution networks face the demand for new energy access and "re electrification", and the integration of information flow and power flow is insufficient, making it difficult to meet the needs of ubiquitous interconnection and collaborative autonomy. This article proposes an automatic topology identification technology for distribution systems based on the Internet of Things. Firstly, the cloud edge collaborative interaction technology was adopted to achieve the interaction between the terminal and the distribution main station, and the automatic association of primary and secondary devices was achieved through plug and play technology. Secondly, by utilizing the sequential closing and power transmission characteristics of intelligent distribution equipment, combined with key technologies such as time synchronization and current surge detection, the precise identification and dynamic updating of the distribution network topology structure were achieved, and the current surge was calculated for verification. Finally, automatic mapping technology was applied to achieve automatic perception and modeling of the distribution network. Simulation results show that this technology provides a comprehensive and feasible solution for IoT perception modeling in distribution networks, which helps to improve the intelligence level and operation efficiency of distribution networks.

articleTitle: Thermal Power Plant Generation Cost Optimization Model in Consideration of Integrated Energy System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To enhance energy utilization efficiency, lower carbon dioxide emissions from thermal power plants, and optimize their power generation costs, the concept of integrated energy systems is proposed. Unlike the conventional single-stage energy utilization methods, integrated energy systems enable multi-stage use of different energy forms, including electricity, heating, cooling, and natural gas, thereby improving overall energy efficiency through the coordinated complementary of multiple energy sources. However, the close interconnection of systems and the intricate dynamics of energy flow result in significant differences in optimal operation between integrated energy systems and traditional power grids. This paper first establishes a mathematical model of the integrated energy system in a thermal power plant. Then, based on considering the balancing power and setting output limits for individual units, a mathematical model with the thermal power generation cost as the objective function is established. Finally, the objective function is optimized by the improved genetic algorithm, the power generation cost of the comprehensive energy system of the optimized thermal power plant is 1120 thousand yuan, which can save 160 thousand yuan less than before the optimization, a decrease of 12.5% year on year, and the results verify the feasibility of thermal power generation cost optimization.

articleTitle: An Optimization Method for Determining the Proportion between Year and Day-ahead Procurement of Frequency Response Reserve
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the continuous increase in the penetration rate of new energy units, the power system needs to purchase frequency response reserve to cope with the shortage of frequency response resources. The ratio of long-term to short-term procurement for frequency response reserve is generally determined based on experience, lacking theoretical basis. This article establishes a year and day-ahead joint model and proposes a method for determining the ratio. The case study shows that the proposed method can determine the optimal procurement ratio between the year and day-ahead, and achieve optimal allocation of frequency response resources at different time scales.

articleTitle: Coordinated Control Strategy of Inertia Support for MMC-HVDC Connecting Offshore Wind Farms Considering Frequency Secondary Drop
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of low inertia support capability and poor frequency stability of power electronic power system, a coordinated control strategy for rapid recovery of wind power speed is proposed to effectively avoid the frequency secondary drop (FSD). An adaptive speed recovery strategy based on variable droop coefficient is designed by logistic function to reduce the power impact of wind power on the system at the moment of inertia support control. On this basis, an adaptive switching strategy for the sub-modules (SMs) of the sending and receiving converter stations is proposed. The energy support margin of MMC-HVDC capacitor is used to compensate the power loss caused by the speed recovery of the wind turbine (WT). The starting criterion and related control parameters are designed based on the key characteristic quantities, which can improve the speed recovery speed while avoiding FSD. Finally, based on the real-time digital simulation platform, a simulation model of MMC-HVDC connecting offshore wind farms is built to verify the effectiveness of the proposed coordinated control strategy.

articleTitle: Research on Key Technologies of Intelligent Inspection Equipment and System Pilot Platform
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Intelligent inspection equipment and systems are important media for implementing machine replacement for substation equipment inspection. In response to the current problems of low reliability of intelligent inspection equipment and insufficient recognition accuracy of intelligent inspection algorithm models for some typical defects, it is necessary to carry out performance testing, functional verification, and reliability assessment of substation intelligent inspection systems, robots, and drones to improve the defect recognition, operation processing capabilities, and reliability of intelligent inspection equipment. This article focuses on the key technologies of intelligent inspection equipment and system pilot platforms, proposing the key technologies of three pilot platforms: extreme environment inspection unmanned aerial vehicles, substation intelligent inspection systems based on artificial intelligence, and high reliability substation inspection robots, and clarifying the on-site verification methods of the platforms.

articleTitle: Adaptive Heuristic Method Based on Reduced Costs and Physical Characteristics of Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to improve the efficiency of solving unit commitment problems, an adaptive heuristic method based on reduced costs and physical characteristics of the power grid is proposed to address the problem of large scale, complex constraints and variables, and difficulty in finding high-quality feasible solutions. Firstly, the physical characteristics of the power grid, the optimal solution to the relaxation problem, and the reduced costs of 0-1 variables for the power model are identified and obtained. Then, based on the model characteristics and relaxation information, accurate variable values are fixed and induced, and the number of fixed variables is adjusted according to the feasibility of constraints until all constraints are met. Finally, finding the optimal solution to the problem with fixed variables. The test results of the numerical examples show that the algorithm can quickly obtain high-quality feasible solutions to the original problem, effectively improving the efficiency of solving the unit commitment problem.

articleTitle: Research on Bifurcation and High-Frequency Stability of the Secondary System in the Measurement Link of Flexible DC Power Transmission
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: During operation of the Chongqing-Hubei & Zhangbei flexible DC projects, high-freq resonances emerged. This article analyzes the dynamics of electromagnetic CTs, constructs a state space model for an isolated flexible DC new energy system with no-load current measurement. Using avg iteration, a current bifurcation diagram under cable param changes is obtained, verifying bifurcation during resonance via simulations. Nonlinear theory explains modulation wave changes & control saturation's effect on resonance. Model accuracy & resonance mechanism are validated through simulations & condition comparisons, offering tech guidance for flexible DC projects.

articleTitle: A Novel Start-up Strategy for High Voltage Cascaded Energy Storage Device
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: High-voltage cascaded energy storage device is a key equipment to improve the stability and flexibility of power grid. This paper proposes a novel start-up strategy for high-voltage cascaded energy storage device, which can simplify the pre-charge circuit of the energy storage device and improve the economy and reliability of the device. Then, the parameter design method of pre-charge circuit is proposed. Finally, PSCAD model is used to simulate the start-up process of the device, verifying the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: Combined Operational Decision Making for Multi-microgrid System Based on Cloud-edge Collaborative Computing Framework
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the utilization of digital intelligence technologies, flexible resources like distributed power generation and storage are being incorporated into modern smart distribution networks (DNs) in the form of microgrids (MGs). Additionally, the interaction between MGs and DN has shifted from a unidirectional power flow, where supply follows demand, to a bidirectional exchange of power and energy based on their operational and economic needs. In this context, this paper proposes a combined operational decision making method for multi-microgrid systems (MMGS) based on a cloud-edge collaborative computing framework. In this framework, the DN's computational resources are viewed as the cloud center, while the MGs act as edge nodes. The edge computing nodes calculate the individual MG optimization models and upload them to the cloud center, where the combined economic dispatch optimization model is computed, along with benefit distribution within the MMGS. Simulations were conducted on the MMGS consisting of a DN and three MGs in different regions. The results confirm the effectiveness of the proposed optimization model.

articleTitle: The Simulation and Analysis of Transformer Winding Based on Voicing Pattern
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To investigate the mechanical condition of transformer windings and identify them through winding voograms, a 66kV transformer was utilized as the research model for conducting simulation analysis. Initially, a simulation model of winding load vibration and noise was established to obtain voltage waveform diagrams and magnetic field distributions on both low and high voltage sides under load conditions. The magnetic leakage density of the winding measured at 0.43T, with displacement amplitude measuring at 0.03mm concentrated primarily at half-height of the winding structure. The average A-phase vibration acceleration amplitude measured at 1.67m/s<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> while B-phase averaged at 1.15m/s<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, C-phase averaged at 1.16m/s<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, with sound pressure amplitudes measuring up to 0.15179Pa in magnitude; comparison with corresponding simulation results indicated that they were consistent with experimental data.

articleTitle: Technical and Economic Analysis of Multi-terminal MMC Flexible DC System for Offshore Wind Power Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The hybrid converter valve based on novel series double sub-modules has a better economy in large-scale offshore wind power integration scenarios. In this paper, the technical economy of a hybrid MMC converter valve based on an improved series double sub-module and half-bridge sub-module is analyzed. Compared with other MMC converter valves with DC fault clearing ability, the hybrid MMC converter valve based on improved series double sub-modules and half-bridge sub-modules is more economical.

articleTitle: Predictive Power Control of AC-DC Matrix Converter Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The non-isolated AC-DC matrix converter has the advantages of high efficiency and high power density. In order to improve the quality of the output power of the AC-DC matrix converter, this paper proposes to combine the virtual space vector with the model predictive power control (MPPC), establish the cost function with power as the control objective, and introduce the active damping current, which can effectively improve the control accuracy of the system and reduce the total harmonic distortion rate of the input current, and the simulation results validate the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Exploration of the Joint Operation Model of Distributed Power Sources and thermal Storage Electric Heating in Rural Areas Transitioning from Coal to Electricity
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In response to the need for clean heating during the heating season in the "Three North" regions of China, a joint operation model of distributed power sources and thermal storage electric heating tailored for rural areas is proposed. First, the application status of existing thermal storage electric boilers in conjunction with photovoltaics and wind turbines is analyzed, alongside the increasing attention and support from governments for independent residential electric heating as the scale of clean energy generation from photovoltaics and wind power continues to grow internationally. Second, the trend of changes in rural power grid loads following the implementation of the "coal-to-electricity" initiative is examined. Third, a heating model is constructed that aims for local consumption of distributed power sources, constrained by the comprehensive operation of the electric heating system. Finally, through practical case studies, the impact of the distributed power source and thermal storage electric heating model on local consumption of distributed power sources and the load rate of grid equipment is analyzed. Simulations are conducted to assess the investment in independent residential distributed power sources and thermal storage electric heating, further demonstrating the effectiveness and practicality of the proposed method.

articleTitle: On the Routing Problem of Power Supply Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The reasonable adjustment of power supply vehicles (PSVs) has a considerable effect on the operational range and efficiency of electric drive equipment in field operations or post-disaster rescue scenarios. It has therefore been proposed that the routing problem of PSVs (PSVRP) be regarded as a novel optimisation problem. This problem can be expressed as a mathematical model comprising two cascaded stages. The first stage involves the assignment of task sets to each PSV, while the second stage pertains to the assignment of task sequences to each PSV. Subsequently, a genetic algorithm based on individual crossover (ICGA) was put forth as a potential solution to PSVRP. A case study comprising 100 task nodes was subsequently devised for the purpose of analysing the performance of ICGA. The results demonstrate that, in comparison with the two algorithms that are currently employed to address vehicle routing problems, ICGA is capable of enhancing performance by 60.9% and 70.79%, respectively.

Author Keywords: routing problem of power supply vehicle

articleTitle: Transient Voltage Support Technology Based on Flexible DC Traction Power Supply Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the super-large urban load center area, motor loads, represented by air conditioning compressors have been increasing annually, posing a severe challenge to power system transient stability. Thanks to the rapid development of flexible DC traction power supply systems (FDTPSSs) in recent years, a new way for transient voltage support has emerged. Through the active and reactive power decoupling control of the voltage source converter (VSC) in FDTPSSs, this paper leverages its redundant reactive power capacity to compensate reactive power swiftly and support transient voltage for the power grid. The proposed transient voltage support scheme adopts variable droop voltage control, where droop gain of the Q-V controller is adaptively adjusted based on the current maximum reactive capacity of each VSC so that more reactive power can be exerted for voltage support. The proposed strategy has been validated in MATLAB/PSAT based on the Beijing Metro Line 13A.

Author Keywords: flexible DC traction power supply system (FDTPSS)

articleTitle: A Novel High-Capacity Cascaded Wind Turbine Converter with High Frequency Link for Fractional Frequency Offshore Wind Power Application
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to adapt to the increasing capacity of single wind turbine, the internal converter as the key equipment of fractional frequency transmission system (FFTS), has attracted more and more attention. Based on modular multilevel technology and cascaded H-bridge technology, in this paper, a novel cascaded wind power converter is proposed. The new topology uses an isolated high-frequency transformer, which replaces the expensive and large transformer used in the low-frequency transformation of wind turbine, which is suitable for medium-voltage and large-capacity wind power system. In the meantime, the overall control scheme is designed. The d-axis zero current control is adopted on the wind turbine side, and the feedforward decoupling control is adopted on the grid side. Considering the secondary voltage fluctuation in the DC side, the control strategy is improved by injecting zero sequence voltage and reforming split capacitors. Finally, simulation model of offshore wind farm composed of permanent magnet direct drive wind turbines using the proposed converter is built in the MATLAB/Simulink. And the feasibility of this proposed topology has been verified through operation performance in different scenarios.

articleTitle: Calculation of the Limit Acceptance Capacity of Renewable Energy
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Due to the randomness and uncertainty of wind power, the integration of wind power into the grid will increase the insecurity factors of the power system, so it is necessary to study the impact of wind power on the power system. In this paper, the maximum active power output of the new energy unit is solved under the combined action of frequency constraint and short-circuit ratio constraint, and the simulation and verification are carried out in MATLAB using the actual system example.

articleTitle: Dynamic Model and Optimal Scheduling for Hydrogen Integrated Multi-Energy System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The multi-energy systems comprising electricity net-works, heating networks, and gas networks is considered a vital strategy for mitigating carbon emissions in the energy sector. Hydrogen utilization and the incorporation of hydrogen-blended transportation offer significant potential for achieving deep decarbonization without incurring additional construction costs. This paper proposes a dynamic model of multi-energy sys-tem with hydrogen-blended transportation based on generalized phasor modeling method. The numerical studies demonstrate the benefits of the proposed multi-energy system model, especially in terms of operational cost reduction and renewable energy accommodation.

articleTitle: An Enhanced Power Quality Improvement Control Strategy for Grid-Connected Inverters
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming to mitigate the issues of serious power quality degradation in distribution networks, this paper proposes an enhanced power quality improvement control strategy for grid-connected inverters. The current reference generation algorithm for the negative sequence and harmonic mitigation is introduced, and a compensation performance assessment method based on the data envelopment analysis is established. Instead of subjectively assigning weights, this method evaluates the relative efficiency of different compensation coefficient combinations based on the real-time power quality measurement. By employing the inverter compensation capacity as the input indicator, and the grid current THD and unbalance factor as the output indicators, the proposed control fully utilizes the actual available capacity of the inverter and realizes a more optimal power quality improvement. Finally, the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed control strategy are verified in Matlab/Simulink.

articleTitle: Ontology-Based Construction of Fault Knowledge Base for Energy-Consuming Equipment
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Blast furnace is a kind of high energy consuming equipment, which is difficult to use because of frequent equipment failures and scattered knowledge in operation. In order to cope with these challenges, the concept of ontology is introduced into the field of blast furnace equipment fault, and the ontology knowledge base of blast furnace equipment fault field is constructed by using the seven-step method, and the specific process of each step is described in detail. Based on ontology modeling tool protege, the fault knowledge of blast furnace equipment is modeled and managed in a systematic and structured way, and information sharing and reuse are realized by analyzing the knowledge of blast furnace fault domain. It is proved that the ontology based knowledge base can automatically mine hidden knowledge and semantic reasoning, and the ontology can guide factory operation and improve the fault handling ability of blast furnace.

articleTitle: Deep Skipping Fusion for Insulator Fault Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This work proposes a deep skipping fusion (DSF) method for insulator fault detection. This work consists of three main steps. First, multi-layer deep features are explored by using a convolutional neural network. Then, multi-layer deep features are fused, and a covariance matrix is calculated for the fused features, which can offer the complementary deep information from various layers. Last, the obtained covariance matrix serves as a feature for classification by a support vector machine. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method can obtain an outstanding diagnosis performance with limited training samples.

articleTitle: Optimal Allocation of Energy Storage Considering Information-energy Cost with High Renewable Penetrations
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Although conventional energy storage optimization has been widely researched, it focuses more on addressing the challenges posed by the high penetration of renewable energy sources (RES) through storage capacity allocation only without considering information. Furthermore, it cannot effectively balance the trade-off between energy and information costs. Therefore, this paper proposes an information-energy perspective on the optimal allocation of energy storage. Firstly, an information-energy optimal allocation method based on entropy for energy storage is proposed. Secondly, a novel cost model evaluating the interaction between information and energy is introduced, which can leverage a larger capacity cost with a smaller information cost. Furthermore, the proposed model enhances the balance between system flexibility and cost-efficiency with high renewable penetrations.

articleTitle: A Coupled Coordination Model to Evaluate "Energy-Economy-Carbon Emission" Synergistic Development in Tianjin
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Energy consumption is the driving force of urban economic development, but the carbon emissions brought by its combustion seriously limit the green and low-carbon transformation of cities. In this paper, a new coupled coordination model is proposed to evaluate the energy-economy-carbon emission synergistic development in the city. The model consists of two sub-models: the coupled degree evaluation model and the coordination degree evaluation model. The coupled degree evaluation model quantitatively describes the relationship between energy, economy, and carbon emission. The coordination degree evaluation model is used to evaluate the status or level of coordination of energy, economy, and carbon emission in developing a low-carbon city. Taking Tianjin as an example, a case study is conducted to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed model. The results show that the energy-economy-carbon synergy in Tianjin has gradually improved from a severe imbalance in the early 2000s to a moderate imbalance recently.
