The shared energy storage can effectively solve the above problems. A robust optimal allocation method for distributed shared energy storage of new energy stations is proposed in this article to enhance system operational flexibility, robustness, and economic efficiency. Firstly, The model of distributed shared energy storage is utilized at new energy stations that are in close electrical distance, and the new energy stations are formed into an alliance, and the cooperation game is carried out to obtain the highest alliance economic benefits. Then, with the uncertainty of renewable energy as the constraints, to guarantee the robustness of the configuration scheme, a robust optimal configuration model of shared energy storage is established. Finally, the Shapley value method is used to make a profit distribution plan to ensure that all alliance participants get reasonable benefits.

articleTitle: Modelling Feasible Operation Region of An Electricity Distribution Network: A Hybrid Simulation-Analytical Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The increasing integration of low-carbon technologies into electricity distribution networks necessitates a thorough understanding of the network' capacity to accommodate these changes. The feasible operation region (FOR), which describes the allowable range of power injections of a distribution network without violating the network constraints, provides a promising solution to describe the overall picture of the network capability. This paper proposes a hybrid simulation-analytical approach for the modelling of FOR boundaries. The hybrid approach uses the dataset that is obtained from simulation to calculate the errors of the analytical expressions due to some impractical assumptions. These errors are then used to adjust the parameters of the analytical FOR boundaries to improve their accuracy. To obtain the optimal parameters for the analytical expressions of FOR boundaries, an interval elimination method is used. The effectiveness of the hybrid simulation-analytical approach has been validated using a feeder of an 11kV high-voltage underground network. The results show that compared to the existing analytical approach for obtaining FOR boundaries, the hybrid approach in this study can improve the accuracy of analytical expressions for different FOR boundaries by 19%-95%. Additionally, the results demonstrate that the same types of FOR boundaries, including thermal boundaries and voltage upper/lower boundaries, tend to have similar optimal parameters, which provides practical insights for efficiently selecting parameters for different FOR boundary types.

articleTitle: Low Carbon Optimization Operation of Power System Considering Ecological Carbon Sink and Renewable Energy
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the process of low-carbon transformation in the power system, exploring the carbon sequestration capacity of ecological carbon sinks(ECS) can generate economic and low-carbon benefits. The paper considers the uncertainty of ECSs, renewable energy sources(RES), and meteorological factors to achieve deep decarbonization. Finally, the paper uses the IEEE-24 bus system for simulation. And the results show that the scenario considering ECSs can reduce the total cost by about 32.76%.

articleTitle: Transient stability control method of virtual synchronous inverter based on minimum stable boundary estimation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: When a serious fault occurs in the power grid, it can lead to transient instability of the inverter, potentially resulting in system collapse. Traditional energy function methods that incorporate damping coefficients may yield stability misjudgments during transient stability analysis. To address this issue, this paper proposes a transient stability control method for virtual synchronous inverters based on minimum stable boundary estimation. A transient energy function that accounts for damping power is developed using the swing equation of synchronous generators. Additionally, a transient voltage stability control method is introduced, which relies on the minimum stability boundary estimation derived from the improved transient energy function. Finally, a model is constructed in Matlab/Simulink to validate the accuracy and effectiveness of the proposed control method. Simulation results demonstrate that the transient stability control strategy based on the enhanced energy function can effectively estimate post-failure transient energy of the inverter and achieve effective stabilization of its operation.

articleTitle: Overview of Research Status and Development of New Power Energy Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The development of the new power energy system is currently at a critical stage of transitioning from perceptual intelligence to cognitive intelligence. Traditional power energy information systems are unable to meet the requirements of digital development. In order to build a stronger digital power grid, the digital transformation of the new power energy system is at an urgent moment. The existing data processing frameworks are divided into two types: data oriented processing frameworks for the entire data process and knowledge graph based processing frameworks. In this article, firstly, starting from the system oriented towards the entire data process, the concept and development of the entire data process oriented approach are introduced, and the six dimensional data composition and six data processing stages of the entire data process oriented approach are analyzed; Then we introduce the system based on knowledge graph, providing a universally recognized definition and development of knowledge graph, and summarize the architecture and methods of knowledge graph; Finally, we analyze and explore the direction of integrating data throughout the entire process and knowledge graph, and provide prospects for the future of new power energy systems.

articleTitle: Study on market pricing for participation of electrochemical energy storage in peaking auxiliary service market
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Under the background of "double carbon" target and new power system construction, in order to ensure the full recovery of the cost of electrochemical energy storage and improve the profitability of electrochemical energy storage, it is necessary to study the pricing problem of the market of electrochemical energy storage participating in the peaking auxiliary service, firstly, from the perspective of the adaptability of energy storage participating in the peaking and the mechanism of the investigation, and then. Construct the pricing model of auxiliary services for electrochemical energy storage participation in peak shifting, and finally, carry out the example verification to conclude that the pricing model can realize the full compensation of energy storage costs, guarantee the reasonable income of the electrochemical energy storage service providers, and promote the healthy and sustainable development of China's electrochemical energy storage industry.

articleTitle: Coordinating Grid-forming Control of MT-HVDC System to Interconnect Renewable Power Bases and Weak Grids
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Using modular multilevel converter (MMC) based multi-terminal high voltage direct current (MT-HVDC) transmission to interconnect renewable power bases and asynchronous power grids is becoming a promising technology and future trend. However, conventional grid-following control faces weak grid oscillation and inertia-less problems. To solve these problems, a unified grid-forming (GFM) control strategy is proposed for all ends of the MT-HVDC system, i.e., both grid-connected and islanded MMCs. The capacitor voltage of MMC submodules is controlled to emulate the rotor speed of SGs, and a multi-target DC-side controller is designed. By distributing the control coefficient of the DC-side controller, the MMC can operate in DC-side GFM mode, AC-side GFM mode and dual-port GFM mode. Furthermore, with the coordinating of grid-forming MMCs, the MT-HVDC system can operate in different droop control modes, realizing more functions such as grid-frequency delivery and active grid frequency support. This method can not only realize the grid-forming control of each end, but also enhance the flexibility and adaptability of the MT-HVDC system. To validate the effectiveness of the proposed strategy, a 5-terminal MMCMTDC transmission system with renewable energy integration is established on the PSCAD/EMTDC simulation platform. The simulation results convincingly verify the efficacy of the control strategy presented in this paper.

articleTitle: Economic Analysis of Typical Business Model of Grid-side Energy Storage Considering Full Life Cycle
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Grid-side energy storage is an indispensable part of the future power system, and its market scale development is at a critical stage. To accelerate the development of the energy storage business model and ensure that energy storage can obtain market income, this paper proposes an economic analysis method for the typical business model of grid-side energy storage considering the full life cycle. Firstly, the transaction mechanisms of two typical business models of grid-side energy storage participating in the spot market and peak shaving market are introduced. Then, the costs of the full life cycle, including the initial investment, O&M, battery swapping and capital of grid-side energy storage, are analyzed. Finally, a method for calculating the economic benefits of grid-side energy storage under a typical business model is proposed, and the relationship between the internal rate of return of energy storage and electricity price & market clearing price is obtained through example analysis, verifying the effectiveness of the method proposed herein.

articleTitle: Research on Privacy Protection Methods for Virtual Power Plant Users Based on Data Precision Desensitization
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid development of the energy Internet, virtual power plants have emerged as an innovative model for the integrated distribution of energy resources. However, during the transmission of information from power plants, there is a risk of users' personal information being leaked. To address this issue, this paper proposes a user-sensitive data protection scheme for virtual power plants, which includes data desensitization, a desensitization algorithm, and an optimized sensitive data scanning approach. The proposed scheme employs a replacement algorithm within the data desensitization process to encrypt and protect sensitive information, such as users' names and electricity consumption behaviors. Simulation analysis demonstrates that this algorithm not only retains key characteristics of electricity consumption data—allowing for meaningful insights during data analysis—but also effectively prevents the exposure of specific values. This enhances the privacy of users' electricity consumption data while achieving dynamic desensitization. Overall, this approach satisfies the data analysis requirements within the virtual power plant framework while effectively safeguarding user privacy, providing a practical solution for balancing rational power data usage with privacy protection.

articleTitle: Considering the Green Environmental Value Attribute of Electricity: A Deep Learning Model for Green Electricity Price Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Against the backdrop of the "dual carbon" goals, the green electricity trading market is gradually developing. Currently, the formation mechanism of green electricity prices is complex, environmental premiums are not unified, and the impact paths are not clear, making the prediction of green electricity prices extremely challenging. Therefore, this paper proposes a deep learning model for forecasting green electricity prices that takes into account the green environmental value attributes of electricity. Firstly, the mechanism of green electricity price formation is studied to explore the impact paths of its influencing factors; then, a quantification index system for green electricity environmental value is constructed; subsequently, the LSTM neural network parameters are optimized using the Whale Optimization Algorithm (WOA) to build the forecasting model; finally, a simulation experiment is conducted in a green electricity market in North China, and the results show that the proposed model has a prediction accuracy of 91.7%, achieving accurate forecasting of green electricity prices, which can provide reference for market trading entities to formulate strategies.

articleTitle: Dynamic Bilinear WLAV Harmonic State Estimation Based on Kalman Filter
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As power electronics technology advances, a significant amount of new energy is being integrated into the distribution network, which makes the harmonic pollution of the power system serious. Therefore, it is necessary to obtain the harmonic states of the grid through harmonic state estimation to target the harmonic pollution. The traditional harmonic state estimation generally needs to solve a nonlinear nonconvex optimization problem, which may lead to the result is only a locally optimal solution, and there is also the problem of convergence difficulty in the computation. To address this, proposed a dynamic bilinear weighted least absolute value (WLAV) harmonic state estimation based on the Kalman filter. The method linearizes the nonlinear measurement equation by introducing auxiliary measurement vectors and auxiliary state vectors, which effectively solves the global optimization and convergence problems. Meanwhile, the Kalman filter can be utilized to track the time change of the harmonic states in real time and realize the accurate dynamic estimation. Finally, the feasibility of the method is verified based on simulation examples.

articleTitle: Transient Voltage Instability Mechanism of New Energy Station Based on Repeated LVRT
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In recent years, new type of voltage fluctuation problem often occurs in the large-scale wind power system, and the traditional suppression strategy can not be applied, there is an urgent need to propose an effective strategy. This paper firstly explains the new transient voltage destabilization mechanism; then verifies the related discriminative methods; finally, the effects of active output and crossing threshold on transient voltage are investigated and verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Pilot Protection for MTDC Grid Based on Phase frequency characteristics of Measured-impedance
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The fault transient characteristics in multi-terminal flexible direct current (MTDC) power grid are complex, and the fault current rises rapidly, which put higher demands on the performance of DC line protection. The article is based on a model of MTDC grid for fault transient analysis. Firstly, the phase frequency characteristics of measured-impedance during internal and external faults were derived, revealing the differences in measured-impedance phase at different fault locations. Then, using the norm ratio of the theoretical and actual measuredimpedance phase in multiple frequency bands on both sides of the line, a highly reliable DC line pilot protection scheme is constructed. The simulation results have verified the correctness of the theoretical analysis, indicating that the method can reliably identify different types of internal and external faults and has strong resistance to transition resistance, and is less affected by noise.

articleTitle: Research on the Scheduling Model Adapted to the Multi Operating Conditions and Wide Power Operation Regulation Characteristics of Coal Power
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the progress of the "three reforms" of coal-fired power plants, the regulation characteristics of the units have undergone significant changes, especially when facing the deep peak shaving, ramp up, and frequency regulation needs of the new power system, it is necessary to modify and adjust the unit combination model with refined objectives. This article deeply analyzes the regulation characteristics and cost impact of the flexibility transformation of coal-fired power plants, constructs a power grid scheduling model for the transformed coal-fired power units, and proposes a day ahead unit combination model that adapts to the multi working condition and wide power regulation characteristics of coal-fired power units, fully exploring and leveraging the systematic regulation role of coal-fired power plants in the energy transformation process.

Author Keywords: multi operating condition wide power characteristics
power grid dispatch model for renovated coal-fired power units

articleTitle: Carbon Emission Analysis of Power Transmission Equipment Based on XLPE Insulated Cables: From Cradle to Gate
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Faced with the critical pressure to decarbonize power systems and develop the green supply chain of grid companies, reducing carbon emissions of power equipment becomes a crucial means to decrease the whole emissions of the system. Therefore, it is necessary to accurately calculate and analyze the carbon emissions of power equipment prior to purposefully reducing the carbon emissions. This paper proposes a carbon footprint calculation model for power equipment represented by XLPE Insulated Cables from a life cycle assessment (LCA) perspective, considering the raw material acquisition, transportation and cable production and transportation process, i.e., from cradle to gate. In each carbon accounting phase, the emission factor method is applied to calculate the carbon emissions. The case study based on a 10kV flame retardant XLPE insulated power cable is analyzed. The results indicate that the carbon emissions of the cable are mainly attributed to the raw material transportation phase (73.2%), followed by the carbon emissions associated with raw material acquisition. Effective advice to reduce carbon emissions of power cables are also analyzed based on the calculation results.

articleTitle: Research on Topology Optimization of a Dual Bridge Wide Voltage Range LCLC Resonant Converter
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the traditional DC/DC structure, LLC resonant converter has been widely used in electric vehicles, new energy power generation, and other energy fields as a superior electric energy DC conversion topology due to its good soft switching characteristics, high energy transmission efficiency, and other advantages, but it is difficult for traditional DC/DC converters to take into account both high efficiency and wide voltage output range. Add a bidirectional switch in the pre-inverter circuit, can make the inverter circuit switch back and forth directly in the half-bridge and the full-bridge, broaden the voltage input range of the pre-stage, simultaneously connect an LC branch in parallel on the primary side of the transformer in the resonator, can make the equivalent excitation inductance of the converter change with frequency rate, and then expand the gain range and reduce the resonant current simultaneously, further weaken the influence of the excitation inductance, finally, replace a diode with an active switch in the rectifier network, can change the rectifier structure by controlling the conduction of this switch tube, which in turn expands the output voltage to twice that of the half-bridge mode. The topology is controlled by frequency conversion and phase shift to achieve the purpose of broadening the output voltage and improving the efficiency, and the principle is analyzed, and the simulation is carried out in the MATLAB/Simulink environment, and the superiority and feasibility of the optimized topology are verified by the simulation of the experimental waveform.

articleTitle: Wide Input Voltage Range LLC Resonant Converter Based on Fuzzy PI Control
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to broaden the input voltage range of the LLC resonant converter and improve its stability under input voltage fluctuations, this paper utilizes the topology transition between the full-bridge (FB) and half-bridge (HB) LLC resonant converter with twofold voltage gain ratio, which can greatly expand its voltage gain range. However, there is an abrupt change in the output voltage during the transition between FB and HB topology, using the traditional PI control strategy in the face of abrupt changes in the operating conditions of the system, it is often difficult to achieve the desired fast dynamic response speed and stability requirements. Therefore, this paper proposes the use of fuzzy PI control, through the fuzzy logic dynamic adjustment of the parameters of the PI controller, to improve the output voltage stability of the system when transition between FB and HB modes under input voltage fluctuation. Simulation experiments show that the fuzzy PI control strategy greatly reduces the output voltage fluctuation and improves the stability of the system when transition between FB and HB modes under input voltage fluctuation compared with the traditional PI control strategy.

articleTitle: Optimal Designation of Surplus Power AC Chopper in New Energy Transmitted by VSC-HVDC System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, a composite capacity AC chopper configuration strategy is introduced. Firstly, the surplus power characteristics and control modes of the VSC-HVDC system are investigated; secondly, the scheme and control logic of the composite capacity AC chopper are investigated on the basis of the fixed-capacity AC chopper; finally, the proposed composite-capacity AC cchopper is proved to have higher control flexibility and control accuracy by simulation comparison.

articleTitle: Analysis of Asymmetrical Fault Short-Circuit Currents in PMSG Considering PLL and Current Inner-Loop Transient Processes
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Recently, Permanent Magnet Synchronous Generator (PMSG) have accounted for an increasing proportion of wind farms. However, the large-scale grid-connection of new energy sources has led to profound changes in the fault transient process of the power system, and asymmetric faults are the faults with the highest probability of occurrence in the power system, which urgently requires an analysis of the asymmetric fault characteristics of the PMSG. Hence, an analytical method for analyzing the short-circuit current of PMSG with asymmetrical faults considering phase-locked loop and current inner loop is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the time-domain analytical equation of short-circuit current of wind turbine taking into account the sequential switching control is established, and the influence law of control parameters on the response characteristics of short-circuit current is analyzed. Then, the effects of current loop and phase-locked loop (PLL) on the phase of short-circuit current are investigated separately, and the phase of output current is solved in time periods. Finally, the electromagnetic transient simulation model of the PMSG is established, and the validity of the short-circuit current analytical equation is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Optimal Scheduling of Virtual Power Plants Considering Distributed PV Volatility
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, we address the optimal scheduling problem of a virtual power plant (VPP) while accounting for the inherent volatility of distributed photovoltaic (DPV) systems. To tackle the challenges posed by the uncertainty in DPV output prediction and the difficulties in coordinating and controlling the DPV, energy storage systems (ESS), and controllable loads, we propose a Bayesian spatio-temporal model for DPV output forecasting. This model is integrated with the demand response of ESS and controllable loads to establish an optimal scheduling framework for the VPP, considering DPV fluctuations. The proposed scheduling model operates in two phases: the day-ahead scheduling phase and the real-time scheduling phase. In the day-ahead scheduling phase, optimization is performed with the objective of maximizing VPP operational revenue, based on the DPV day-ahead forecast. In the real-time scheduling phase, the actual DPV output is used to adjust the day-ahead plan, and real-time optimization is conducted with the goal of minimizing the net load fluctuations within the system. Simulation experiments validate the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed model. The results demonstrate that the model significantly enhances VPP operational efficiency, smooth the system's net load curve, and mitigates the impact of DPV volatility on system performance.

articleTitle: Stability analysis of grid-connected inverter systems based on sequential impedance modelling accounting for grid strength
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increasing number of renewable energy sources connected to the grid, the stability of grid-connected inverter systems has attracted much attention. The effect of grid strength on stability has also become a hot research topic. In order to investigate the influence of grid strength on the grid-connected inverter system, this paper firstly constructs a grid-connected inverter system containing a grid-constructing inverter and a grid-following inverter, and then adopts the harmonic linearization method to derive the sequential impedance model of the two inverters. Based on the sequential impedance model, a three-port equivalent model of the grid-connected inverter system taking into account the grid strength is established. The stability of the grid-connected inverter system is analyzed by plotting the Nyquist curve. In addition, a simulation model is established, and the Nyquist curves are compared with the simulation results to verify the correctness of the obtained conclusions, which lays the foundation for the future design of system parameters and optimization of control strategies.

articleTitle: A Extended State Observer Based Backstepping Control for Improving Stability of DC-DC Boost Converters with Constant Power Loads
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In DC microgrid, constant power loads are connected to the DC main bus through the Boost converter, and these constant power loads introduce negative impedance, making it difficult to stabilize the DC bus voltage. In order to improve the stability of the system, this paper proposes a composite controller that combines backstepping control (BSC) with extended state observer (ESO) for Boost converter. First, the system model is transformed to the Brunovsky’s canonical form by exact feedback linearization. Second, in order to improve the robustness of the system, the external disturbances, model uncertainty and aggregate uncertainty term disturbances are estimated and compensated by extended the state observer. Then, the use of backstepping control ensures fast voltage tracking while solving the non-minimum phase problem of the Boost converter. Finally, the simulation was verified in MATLAB/Simulink. The results show that the proposed controller is capable of global tracking and fast response of voltage in the face of reference voltage variations, power fluctuations, and inaccuracies in circuit component parameters.

articleTitle: Information Modelling of Battery Energy Storage System Based on IEC 61850 Object-Oriented Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Battery energy storage system (BESS) is an important part of the new type power systems. With the continuous growth of BESS scale, it is essential to effectively characterize the huge amount of BESS monitoring data. However, different communication protocols lead to a decrease in monitoring efficiency and an increase in system integration costs. On the basis of analyzing the BESS hierarchical structure and the battery management system (BMS) three-level architecture, various information required to characterize energy storage systems are clarified. The object-oriented modeling technique of IEC 61850 is deeply analyzed. Based on the IEC 61850 object-oriented modeling method, an interoperable energy storage system information model is established and applied to a typical BESS, laying the foundation for improving the safety of energy storage system operation, efficient control, and achieving interoperability between devices.

articleTitle: Research on the Verification Method of Power Communication Data Based on Multi-domain Data Unification
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This article proposes a multi domain joint verification method covering equipment, optical cables, and services in the backbone and data network. A device verification method based on overload verification and an optical cable joint verification method based on same site, route, and channel analysis are established, which realizes the correlation verification of business data, achieves consistency and correlation verification of network for protection and safety control services.

articleTitle: Equipment Failure Risk Prediction Method Based on Health Index
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Device health management is currently a hot topic in device management theory. Managing devices based on their asset and physical attributes is more conducive to comprehensive and integrated equipment management throughout their entire lifecycle. Based on the definition of health index and different stages of health index, this article presents a method for predicting equipment failure risk based on health index, provides risk assessment standards, establishes a risk assessment model, and comprehensively determines the risk level through equipment importance index, equipment risk index, failure probability, and failure loss index.

articleTitle: Research on the Spillover Risk of Two-Tier Inter- and Intra-Provincial Electricity Spot Markets
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increasingly close relationship between the two-tier Inter- and Intra-Provincial Electricity Spot Markets, in order to explore the impact between different markets, this paper studies the risk spillover effect of the inter-provincial spot market on the intra-provincial spot market from the perspective of post-risk assessment. Firstly, the commonly used spillover risk measurement index ΔCoVaR is introduced as the basis for judging the size of the risk. Secondly, based on quantile regression and DCC-GARCH module, the calculation model of inter-provincial spillover risk to intra-provincial spot market is established. Finally, the spillover risk of the day-ahead and intra-day electricity spot market in a province of China is analyzed. It is found that in the day-ahead stage, the inter-provincial electricity spot market will have a positive price spillover risk to the intra-provincial electricity spot market price, while in the intra-day stage, the interprovincial electricity spot market will frequently have a negative price spillover risk to the intra-provincial electricity spot market price.

articleTitle: Simulation Research on GIS Temperature Field Distribution Characteristics under Different Influencing Factors
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Gas Insulated Switchgear (GIS) is widely used in power systems, but it is still faced with problems such as difficult detection of heat loss, high current density, and large eddy current loss, which threaten the dependable operation of the system. Therefore, in this study, the electromagnetic and temperature field distribution characteristics of GIS are explored and their distribution rules are revealed through the multi-physics coupled simulation of electromagnetic-flow-thermal fields. At the same time, the influence of sunshine radiation, rated current and ambient temperature on GIS temperature distribution is analyzed. The outcomes demonstrate that in the GIS cross section, a left-right symmetrical physical pat-tern may be seen in its temperature distribution, with the upper temperature being greater than the lower temperature; Sunlight radiation has a significant impact on GIS temperature increase; The biggest factor influencing the GIS's temperature rise is its operational current; The effect of external environmental temperature on GIS temperature rise is less obvious.

articleTitle: Research on optimization of pricing strategies for inter and intra provincial electricity spot markets based on deep reinforcement learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As the construction of inter provincial markets becomes increasingly mature, strategic generation companies (GenCo) need to consider the impact of inter provincial spot markets, collaborate to optimize their pricing strategies in the two-tier market, and improve profits. This article uses deep reinforcement learning to construct an intelligent agent, simulating power generators participating in inter provincial spot market as price receiver and attend intra provincial spot market transactions as price setters. By using the deep deterministic policy gradient algorithm, the load forecasting data during the bidding period and the node electricity prices during the competition process are taken as state variables, and their declared electricity prices and retention amounts in the provincial spot market are used as bidding strategies. This enables the agent to gradually learn the environment during the bidding process and optimize its own bidding strategy based on profits. The case study validates the effectiveness of the model proposed in this paper and can improve the bidding revenue of GenCos.

articleTitle: Frequency-Voltage Coordinated Regulation Method based on Support Capability of Wind-Storage Combined Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The wind-storage combined system (WSCS) can solve the frequency and voltage capability problems caused by the intermittent and fluctuating wind power in large-scale wind farms. However, there is a challenge in how to fully utilize the support capabilities of energy storage systems (ESS) and wind farms (WFs) to participate in frequency regulation (FR) and voltage regulation (VR). To address this challenge, a frequency and voltage coordinated regulation (FVCR) method is proposed, which is divided into three parts: 1) A WFs frequency support capability quantification strategy, which respectively considers the kinetic energy equation and power characteristics, is conducted to maximize the WTs frequency support capabilities. 2) An ESS frequency support capability quantification strategy, which considers the ESS’s state of charge (SoC), is established to evaluate the ESS performance. 3) A frequency and voltage coordinated regulation strategy, which consider the different support capabilities of WFs and ESS, is proposed to reasonably coordinate FR and VR under the capacity constraint. Numerous test results are analyzed to verify the effectiveness and performance of the proposed FVCR method of WSCS.

articleTitle: Application of MSA-UNet Based on Multi-scale Features and Attention Mechanism Optimization in Drone Photovoltaic Panel Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This study introduces MSA-UNet (Multi-Scale Attention U-Net), an optimized deep learning network for photovoltaic panel recognition in UAV remote sensing images. With rapid advancements in the photovoltaic industry, precise recognition and monitoring of spatial distributions are increasingly essential. Conventional methods face limitations in accuracy due to challenges such as complex backgrounds, variable lighting, and similarities between photovoltaic panels and other ground objects. This paper presents two primary enhancements to the classic U-Net architecture to construct MSA-UNet: (1) a multi-scale feature extraction module that integrates pyramid pooling and dilated convolution, expanding the receptive field to better detect photovoltaic panels of varied scales and improve both large and small object recognition; and (2) a channel attention mechanism, which dynamically adjusts weights during decoding to enhance focus on target areas, thereby effectively reducing background interference and improving segmentation accuracy. Results show that MSA-UNet significantly improves recognition performance, increasing IoU from the base model's 71.5% to 82.0% and Dice coefficient from 73.2% to 84.1%. These findings provide a robust and efficient tool for automated photovoltaic panel detection, supporting optimized layout and resource management in the photovoltaic industry.

articleTitle: Multi-Time Scale Optimization of Agricultural Energy Internet Considering Coupling of Electricity, Heat, and Ammonia
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the cross-integration of agriculture and energy industry, the energy integration and optimization of agricultural parks has gradually become a research hotspot. Considering the multi-energy coupling in the agricultural production process, this paper constructs an operational architecture of an agricultural energy internet (AEI) consisting of power, heat, and ammonia equipment. Due to the limitations of forecasting technology, there are deviations in the predicted values of wind power, photovoltaics, and loads within AEI during the day-ahead and intra-day stages, which will lead to energy imbalance problems. To address the issue, a multi-time scale optimization strategy is proposed in this paper, including a long-term scheduling strategy for the day-ahead stage and a short-term correction strategy for the intra-day stage. In addition, a rolling optimization method based on the model predictive control algorithm is adopted in the intra-day stage, which achieves a tracking optimization and adaptive online correction of the day-ahead scheme. The research results indicate that the proposed strategy can effectively mitigate prediction errors and has good economic viability.

articleTitle: Calculating the Temperature Rise during the Starting Process of a Large-capacity Line Start Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper investigates the effect of the starting process on the temperature distribution of a large-capacity line-start permanent magnet synchronous motor (LSPMSM). An electromagnetic model for a 630 kW LSPMSM is developed, and the variations in different losses during the starting process are analyzed. The starting process is divided into multiple stages, with the transient temperature rise for each stage approximated as a steady-state temperature rise for calculation purposes. By integrating these results, the overall temperature rise and distribution of the motor are determined. Finite element analysis (FEA) software is utilized to simulate temperature variations throughout the starting process. Experimental findings confirm the temperature rise profile during startup, offering valuable insights into the risk of irreversible demagnetization in permanent magnets and providing a reference for motor design and optimization.

Author Keywords: Line start permanent magnet synchronous motor (LSPMSM)

articleTitle: Scenario Extraction and Complementarity Analysis of Cascade Hydropower-Photovoltaic Hybrid System using UMAP and DPC
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Combining photovoltaic (PV) power with a cascade hydropower (CHP) system is an effective way to promote the consumption of PV. However, the PV uncertainties create challenges to the traditional operation of pure CHP system and thereby cause difficulties in the analysis of complementarity. Typical scenarios generation method is a choice to solve this problem. However, the conventional clustering-based scenario reduction methods have low accuracy and struggle to address high-dimensional feature data. Therefore, this paper proposed a typical scenario extraction method based on the unified manifold approximation and projection (UMAP) algorithm and density peaks clustering (DPC) algorithm. The global and local structure information of feature data can be captured accurately, so the spatial and temporal correlation characteristics between the uncertain CHP and PV variables can be reserved. Thus, optimal typical scenarios of complementary operation can be extracted. The proposed method is applied on a practical hybrid system, the effectiveness is verified and the complementarity is analyzed based on several indexes.

articleTitle: Optimized Operation of a Photovoltaic Storage Charging Station Considering Photovoltaic Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the PV power generation system, which is intermittent due to time and climate factors, and cannot be matched with electric vehicle charging demand in real time, an energy storage system is added to the PV charging station, and an optimal scheduling of energy storage based on PV energy storage charging station is proposed. Firstly, the PV uncertainty is analyzed, and the energy storage operation strategy is formulated by combining the peak and valley leveling tariffs. Secondly, the number of cycles of the energy storage system is converted to the cost of battery loss, which is included in the optimization objective, and then an economic optimization model of the energy storage system of the photovoltaic charging station is established, with the minimum daily operating cost of the photovoltaic charging station as the objective function, which ensures that the load of the charging station achieves peak elimination and valley filling while maximizing the benefits of the charging station, and finally, the optimal economic scheduling of energy storage with the minimum daily operating cost is obtained through the solving of the example, which shows that the proposed optimization method is effective and efficient in scheduling energy storage. The results show that the proposed optimization method effectively achieves peak elimination and valley filling, and maximizes the economic benefits of the charging station.

articleTitle: Collaborative Control of Gravity-Electrochemical Hybrid Energy Storage and Evaluation of Its Operating Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Gravity energy storage, as an energy storage system, is a novel type of energy storage system that converts mechanical and electrical energy using solid heavy energy storage media. Electrochemical energy storage, as a power-type energy storage device, has a quick response time. This research proposes a hybrid energy storage system that combines gravity energy storage with electrochemical energy storage to enable precise grid-side power demand tracking via collaborative control of gravity and electrochemical energy storage. A collaborative control technique for gravity and electrochemical energy storage is developed to accomplish the hybrid energy storage system's steady power output. Firstly, a hybrid energy storage simulation model was constructed on the PSCAD/EMTDC platform using the architecture of the hybrid energy storage system, which consists of gravity energy storage and electrochemical energy storage. Secondly, due to electrochemical energy storage responds quickly to changes in grid power, a collaborative control strategy between the two energy storage methods was proposed. This strategy compensates for the difference between the real-time output power of gravity energy storage units and the power demand on the grid side. Lastly, the effects of various power configurations of electrochemical energy storage on the operational parameters of the hybrid energy storage system was investigated, and the efficacy of the suggested technique was confirmed using the developed hybrid energy storage simulation model.

articleTitle: Research on Cost Optimization Dispatching of Microgrids Based on Improved Particle Swarm Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The significant integration of renewable energy sources has brought many uncertainties to the power system, posing challenges to the construction of a new type of power system. Microgrids are a flexible and resilient improvement solution compared to traditional centralized power grids. They play a positive role in promoting the integration of new energy sources and have become an effective solution to enhance the reliability and operational efficiency of power systems. This paper constructs a microgrid model consisting of various types of generators, with the objective function of minimizing the total cost composed of operating costs and environmental costs. This study utilizes an enhanced particle swarm algorithm that improves upon the traditional method by fine-tuning the inertia factor and learning factor, as well as incorporating adaptive mutation operations. The case study findings reveal that the enhanced particle swarm algorithm demonstrates notable enhancements in performance over the conventional particle swarm algorithm, with an approximate 16.109% increase in computational speed and an average cost saving of about 4.886%.

articleTitle: Research on Dynamic Pricing and Operation Optimization Strategies for Virtual Power Plants Based on Stackelberg Game Theory
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Virtual power plant (VPP) can provide flexible service for the safe operation of low-carbon power system. This paper introduces virtual power plant operator (VPPO) to manage multiple VPPs. Based on the Stackelberg game theory, the dynamic pricing strategy of VPPO and the device operation strategy within VPPs are simultaneously optimized. The method proposed can ensure VPPs achieve optimal economic benefits while considering environmental costs, and VPPO achieve optimal efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on a Three-Phase Phase-Locked Loop Based on Improved SOGI-DDSRF
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Under the trend of weak grid in the power system, traditional SRF-PLL can no longer meet the demand. At present, second-order generalized integrators (SOGI) are widely used to filter out harmonic pollution. However, traditional SOGI has no suppression effect on DC bias and its ability to suppress low order harmonics near the fundamental wave is limited according to its characteristics. DDSRF is widely used to extract positive and negative sequence components, but it is greatly affected by harmonics. This article proposes an improved dual synchronous coordinate system decoupling phase-locked loop and an improved second-order generalized integrator (SOGI) structure composite front-end PLL considering unbalanced operating conditions, harmonic pollution, DC bias, etc. Through the construction of a simulation platform, it is verified that the new phase-locked loop can effectively lock the frequency and phase of the fundamental voltage under complex operating conditions.

articleTitle: Lightweight Model-based Intelligent Object Detection for Digital Twin in Infrastructure Construction Progress
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Objection detection is a key aspect of digital twin enabled intelligent construction progress monitoring and management. However, the construction phase of power infrastructure engineering differs from conventional scenarios and is susceptible to various influencing factors, making it difficult to perform accurate object detection in such complex scenarios. This paper proposes a lightweight object detection framework that combines a lightweight neural network model with image enhancement algorithms and attention mechanisms, enabling accurate detection results with fewer model parameters. Firstly, to address issues of image detail loss and low-light images, the MSRCP algorithm and an image contrast enhancement algorithm based on an exposure fusion framework are used for image enhancement. A lightweight Mask R-CNN is then constructed, introducing depthwise separable convolution in place of convolution, significantly reducing the number of parameters. Additionally, a Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM) is incorporated into the backbone network of the model to enhance the network's feature extraction capability. Experimental results demonstrate that, on a construction dataset collected from power infrastructure engineering construction scenarios, the proposed method achieves a mAP of 86.11%.

articleTitle: Crack Defect Detection Based on Multi-frequency Balanced Electromagnetic Field Measurements
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Traditional eddy current detection technology has a good detection effect on pipeline cracks, but it is limited by the skin effect only to detect cracks on pipeline surface. This paper proposes a multi-frequency balanced electromagnetic field measurement (MF-BEFM) method to detect crack defects. First, the principle of balanced electromagnetic detection is introduced. Secondly, the multi-frequency excitation strategy of synchronous additive synthesis is adopted to achieve different skinning depths by using response signals of different frequencies. Finally, through the MF-BEFM test, the multi-frequency method can be verified by comparison to realize the detection of surface and buried defects. The results show that the peak value of the multi-frequency balanced electromagnetic signal increases approximately linearly with the increase of the defect depth.

articleTitle: Online Monitoring of Zinc Oxide Lightning Arrester for Electromagnetic Signal Interference
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The metal lightning arrester in a substation is an important device for protecting the safe operation of the power grid and preventing atmospheric overvoltage. To monitor the operation status of zinc oxide lightning arrester in real time, this paper proposes a MOA online monitoring method, which fully considers the electromagnetic interference noise on voltage acquisition and conducts real-time online monitoring of MOA. Specifically, the empirical mode decomposition method is proposed to remove the electromagnetic noise in the original voltage signal and eliminate the electromagnetic interference. By using the harmonic analysis method to implement the fast Fourier transform operation on the voltage and current signal, the calculation is simplified, and the resistance, fundamental wave resistance and third harmonic current of the arrester are obtained. Experiments show that the method can effectively remove electromagnetic noise and useless information, retain effective information, and effectively monitor the running state of zinc oxide arrester. It has been proven that the method proposed in this article has good performance in monitoring the operation of zinc oxide lightning arresters and is more suitable for solving such problems.

articleTitle: An AI Weather Downscaling Method for Wind Power Forecasting Considering Terrain Features
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The weather prediction results are critical for wind power forecasting, even a minor deviation in wind speed prediction can result in significant power forecasting error. Numerical Weather Prediction (NWP), which is mainly used for power forecasting, the spatial resolution is low and cannot encompass each wind turbine within the wind farm, thus affecting the power forecasting accuracy. Terrian is the key factor that affects the flow field inside the wind farm. To enhance the precision and reliability of weather prediction, an AI weather downscaling method for wind power forecasting considering terrain features with global forecast field as input is proposed in this paper. Firstly, an improved U-Net-based downscaling model is developed to effectively extract and integrate the correlations among meteorological elements and their spatial correlations. Then, a terrain perception fusion model based on multi-task learning is established to extract topographic features of the wind farm, including elevation, slope, aspect, and curvature of the change of slope. Finally, these features are integrated with the aforementioned downscaling model through the attentional mechanism, thereby realizing a downscaling approach considering terrain features. A wind farm in Northern China is used as an example to verify the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed method, the results show that, the prediction error can be reduced by 0.94 m/s (32.52%) when compared to NWP, 0.26 m/s (11.76%) when compared to the downscaling model without considering terrain features.

articleTitle: Research on the Operation of Complementary Microgrid System for Wind-Solar-Hydro-Storage Based on DEPSO
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increasing demand for green energy transition, multi-energy complementary microgrid systems that integrate wind, solar, hydro, and storage have become a popular research focus due to their efficient, clean, and stable energy supply characteristics. This system combines wind power, photovoltaics, hydropower, and energy storage, effectively mitigating the output fluctuations of renewable energy sources, achieving self-sufficiency, and enabling flexible energy regulation. In response, this paper establishes a model aimed at minimizing system fluctuations and optimizing economic performance, taking into account various system constraints. The model is solved using the Differential Evolution Particle Swarm Optimization (DEPSO) algorithm. Through case analysis, both the Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) algorithm and the DEPSO algorithm are applied to the multi-energy complementary microgrid system, allowing a comparative analysis of equipment output and total operating costs. The experimental results confirm the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

Author Keywords: differential evolution particle swarm optimization algorithm

articleTitle: Design and Application of Power Data Asset Pricing Model Based on Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of inconsistent data value evaluation standards and lack of dynamic adjustment mechanism in the current power data pricing process, a power data pricing model based on reinforcement learning is proposed. Firstly, the random forest algorithm is used to construct a model to calculate the importance of features, and the degree of each feature affecting the pricing strategy is obtained to mine the data value. Secondly, the power data pricing model of Q learning algorithm is constructed to determine the data value evaluation standard. Finally, the dynamic adjustment price based on Q learning algorithm is completed, and the dynamic pricing of power data is realized. At the same time, the experimental results show that the scheme satisfies the dynamic adjustment mechanism of the real market.

articleTitle: Analysis of Security and Stability Characteristics in New Power System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As China's power grid development has entered the stage of constructing New Power System, it is essential to analyze in advance the new security and stability problems and challenges that will be brought to the power system by the change of power production structure and the change of power grid development pattern. Combined with the practical projects and the development trends of New Power System, this paper sorts out the typical transmission configurations of China's power systems from both current and future perspectives. At present, these configurations include large-scale renewable energy transmission through AC-DC systems, bundled transmission of renewable energy and thermal power, centralized transmission of high-proportion hydropower, large-capacity DC feeding to receiving systems, and high-penetration distributed generation into receiving systems. In the future, as the proportion of renewable energy increases, these existing configurations will persist, along with new configurations such as long-distance transmission from large wind and photovoltaic bases like Shagehuang and integrated hydropower-wind-photovoltaic transmission from regions like Southeast Tibet. Based on actual project cases, this paper identifies security and stability problems of the above typical transmission patterns, including voltage stability, power angle stability, and frequency stability. The research results of this paper will lay the foundation for the security and stability analysis and control research of New Power System in the future.

articleTitle: Dispatch Method of Township Industrial Park Integrated Energy System Considering Power to Ammonia and Biomass Waste Energy Conversion
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The green transformation and energy development in township areas are important in building a modern energy system. However, the introduction of chemical industries not only promotes township revitalization but also brings serious pollution problems. This paper proposes a low-carbon dispatch method for the integrated energy system in township industrial park considering power to ammonia and biomass waste energy conversion. Firstly, A two-stage model of power to ammonia and a biomass waste energy conversion model is constructed, and their energy flow relationship is established. Secondly, the joint production unit in the industry park is constructed, and the coupling characteristics of electricity, heat, gas, and carbon power are analyzed. Finally, aiming at the lowest total cost of the industry park operation, the comparative analysis of different scenarios proves that the proposed scheduling method has a better improvement effect on the industry park, which can provide theoretical support for the adjustment of township industrial structure and energy transformation.

articleTitle: Coordinated Energy Management for Multi-Island Microgrids and Hybrid Electric Ships Considering Carbon Emission
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The significant environmental impact of maritime transportation has driven increased interest in adopting electricity as a cleaner and more sustainable energy source for the sector. In this paper, we propose a mixed-integer linear programming (MILP) model to optimize energy management of multi-islands microgrids with hybrid electric ships (HES), in which the coupling between electric power system and maritime transportation system is utilized to reduce the operational costs and carbon emissions. In this electric-maritime coupling integrated energy system (EMC-IES), HES can act as a bridge for energy transfer between islands by charging/discharging with microgrids, thus facilitating the integration of renewable energy. The case studies demonstrate that the proposed coordinated energy management framework effectively reduces operation costs, lowers carbon emissions of EMC-IES.

articleTitle: Active Power Response Rapidity of Variable Speed Pumped Storage Units with Full-Size Converter under Different Coordination Control Modes
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The variable-speed pumped storage unit (VSPSU) with full-size converter (FSC) is characterized by its wide regulation range and fast power response. There is a significant difference in active power responses under two coordination control modes—fast power control mode and fast speed control mode. Quantitative comparison of power response rapidity under two control modes needs to be studied. In this paper, a model of a variable-speed pumped storage plant with full-size converter in turbine condition is built by applying MATLAB/Simulink. An evaluation system of power response rapidity (A_<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">vspsu</inf>) is established by application of Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP). Power step commands and slope commands are set for numerical simulations to analyze regulation characteristics and quantify differences in active power response rapidity under two control modes. Preliminary results demonstrate that, under step commands, when power decreases by 10%, 20%, and 30%, A_<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">vspsu</inf> in fast power control mode is 2.2, 3.4, and 8.1 times A_<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">vspsu</inf> in fast speed control mode, respectively; under slope commands, when power decreases by 10%, 20%, and 30%, A_<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">vspsu</inf> in fast power control mode is 1.9, 3.4, and 15.0 times A_<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">vspsu</inf> in fast speed control mode, respectively. Under both types of power command signals, as the magnitude of power reduction increases, advantages in power response rapidity under fast power control mode become more evident. This paper could contribute to the selection of coordination control modes of a variable-speed pumped storage plant with full-size converter.

articleTitle: Charging pricing strategy for community electric vehicles based on evolutionary game
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The load of the smart grid includes traditional load and active load. The active load on the distribution network side in China is mainly composed of electric vehicles. One of its important characteristics is that power demand changes with electricity prices. With the popularity of electric vehicles, agent is set to play a significant role in the charging management of electric vehicles within the community. Formulating the pricing and power purchase strategies of agents in such a way that a win-win situation for agents and electric vehicle owners can be achieved has become an important research topic. For the above reasons, a pricing and power purchase strategy for community agents is proposed. The pursuit of maximizing interests by agents and vehicle owners is modeled as an evolutionary game. The MILP method is used to transform the nonlinear constraints therein into linear constraints. Finally, a practical example is used to illustrate the basic characteristics of the proposed method and verify the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed scheduling optimization method. Eventually, the globally optimal pricing strategy was obtained.

articleTitle: Power Flow Calculation of Multi-voltage Level DC Microgrid Based on DAB
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The DC transformer based on Dual Active Bridge (DAB) converter has significant advantages and has broad application prospects in future multi voltage level DC distribution networks. Current research lacks power flow model and equivalent circuit models for DC transformers. Firstly, the steady-state mathematical model of DAB's DC transformer was derived. Secondly, the π - type equivalent circuit model was derived, and based on this, a method for model equivalence was proposed, which can quickly and accurately calculate the power flow of multi voltage level DC distribution networks containing multiple DC transformers, greatly reducing the time for power flow solving. Finally, the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed model and method were verified using the modified IEEE 14 node DC distribution network.

articleTitle: A photovoltaic power generation prediction method based on SAO-CNN-BiLSTM-Attention
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To improve the precision of photovoltaic (PV) power forecasting, this research introduces a novel hybrid model that integrates several advanced techniques: the improved algorithm for the empirical mode decomposition of adaptive noise complete ensembles (ICEEMDAN), permutation entropy (PE), the snow ablation optimization algorithm (SAO), an attention-driven convolutional neural network (CNN), and a bidirectional long short-term memory network (BiLSTM). Comparative experiments reveal that the proposed SAO-CNN-BiLSTMAttention model significantly outperforms the efficiency of both the CNN-BiLSTM and CNN-BiLSTM-Attention models, demonstrating remarkable accuracy and stability in short-term PV power predictions. This advancement illustrates the efficacy of combining these sophisticated methodologies to enhance forecasting capabilities in the renewable energy sector.

articleTitle: Fault Analysis of Zhejiang Power Grid in China during 2024 Super Typhoon Gaemi
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In recent years, the increasingly frequent extreme weather events have impacted the power grid and caused severe economic losses. From 24 July to 27 July 2024, the power distribution network was damaged by typhoon Gaemi in Zhejiang Province in China, resulting in power outages in some areas. Based on the data collected by Zhejiang Power Grid during typhoon Gaemi, this paper first introduces the meteorological characteristics of super typhoon Gaemi. Then, we analyze the fault of distribution networks from disaster distribution, fault causes and response methodology of the power grid. Finally, existing problems with the power grid are illustrated. To respond to these problems, we give relevant recommendations to improve the power grid's ability to withstand typhoon disasters.

articleTitle: Vibration detection of power equipment based on sound and video fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Power equipment such as compressors and generators are not only complex in electrical structure, but also precise in mechanical design. During their operation, it is easy to produce mechanical vibration. Therefore, it is very important to carry out vibration detection on the power equipment, which helps to prevent equipment failure during operation and ensure the safe and stable operation of the power system. Based on this, this paper proposes a power equipment vibration detection method based on acoustic image and visible light image fusion. In the data preprocessing stage, shallow data fusion technology is used. This fusion technology integrates data from different sensors or data sources at a lower level. Then, the information collected by the visible light image feature extraction module and the sound information acquisition module is fused at the feature level. Finally, the vibration state of the power equipment is detected by the Transformer-based conditional detection head. The test results show that the method provided in this paper effectively improves the ability to detect the vibration state of power equipment, and can effectively meet the needs of equipment vibration state detection in power system safety construction.

articleTitle: Transient Stability Analysis between Grid-connected Inverter and Energy Storage Converter Within Offshore Wind Power Collection Station
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The offshore wind power collection station equipped with energy storage converters is a crucial measure to address the random fluctuations in offshore wind power grid connection. This paper focuses on the scenario where excess offshore wind generation results in stored energy in the energy storage system. It provides a detailed derivation of the power angle characteristic curves and the critical fault clearing time between the grid-forming converters used for offshore wind power grid connection and those used for energy storage systems. On this basis, the factors affecting the transient stability of the offshore wind power collection station are analyzed, and simulation verification is conducted in a tested system.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Optimization Method of Virtual Power Plant Using Aquila Optimizer Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The virtual power plant is in an emerging stage, but most of the optimization of the virtual power plant stays in the case of achieving a single objective function optimization. To solve this problem, this paper comprehensively considers three objective functions to complete the multi-objective optimization of virtual power plant. Firstly, the virtual power plant is modeled, and the corresponding objective functions and constraints are obtained. Then, an optimal evaluation method combination model based on the principle of minimum variance is proposed. The indexes of each objective function in the virtual power plant are weighted, and the optimal solution of the model is solved to determine the optimal combination weight of the indexes, so that the individual evaluation of multiple objective functions of the virtual power plant is transformed into a single objective evaluation of the whole virtual power plant. Finally, the Aquila Optimizer Algorithm is used to obtain the optimal scheme of the overall objective function of the virtual power plant, and the comprehensive optimization of multiple objectives of the virtual power plant is realized.

articleTitle: Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning-based Two-stage Coordinated Scheduling and Operation Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As the randomness and intermittency brought by the increasing renewable energy sources and emerging loads intensify, traditional scheduling plans and intraday dispatch methods struggle to fully address the source and load fluctuations. Achieving coordinated optimization between economic efficiency and system robustness has become a key research direction. This paper employs the Value-at-Risk (VaR) metric to quantify the potential risks posed by system uncertainties. In the day-ahead scheduling stage, the dispatch objectives include minimizing the day-ahead cost of generating units, interconnection line costs, reserve costs and system risk costs, and reserve availability was verified to ensure the economic efficiency and robustness of day-ahead scheduling plan. In the intraday dispatch stage, a multi-agent real-time intraday dispatch model is proposed, adopting the MAPPO framework. The primary objective is to minimize the redispatch cost of generating units and the penalty costs for curtailing wind, solar power, and load shedding. Finally, the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed model and methodology are evaluated through a devised IEEE 39-bus case.

articleTitle: Accelerated Online Computation of Instantaneous Axis Orbit Features of Rotating Machinery Based on FPGA Parallel Computing Advantage
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that it is difficult to accurately describe the non-stationary vibration behavior of rotating machinery rotor system by the traditional method, based on the full spectrum theory, it is proposed to use the transient axis orbit to describe the transient state of rotating machinery shaft system vibration, and the method of calculating the characteristic indexes of the transient axis orbit is deduced. Firstly, the instantaneous axis orbit is defined, and the characteristic indexes described by the axis orbit are extended to the transient state. Second, the target order waveform parameters are extracted based on the Hilbert transform. Finally, the instantaneous axis orbit features are derived based on the instantaneous waveform parameters. And the algorithm is deployed on FPGA, and the Hilbert transform instantaneous waveform parameter solving module and instantaneous elliptic axis orbit parameter solving module are designed, and the implementation method and interface design of the sub-modules are given.

articleTitle: A Fast Risk Assessment Method for Power System Considering Wind Power Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the large-scale integration of renewable energy into the power grid, its uncertainty brought an impact on the economic and stable operation of power system, and the challenges faced by power system risk assessment are becoming increasingly serious. This paper proposes a fast risk assessment method for power system based on multi-parametric programming theory, which could fully quantify the load shedding risk and wind power curtailment risk caused by wind power uncertainty. First, the parameter space of wind power is represented as a set of multiple critical regions based on optimal partition and KKT conditions, and the linear mapping relationship matrices corresponding to each critical region are obtained. The risk indicators of power system with specific wind power scenarios could be directly calculated through these matrices, which accelerates the process of risk assessment and provides a reference for improving the efficiency of power system risk assessment with the integration of renewable energy.

articleTitle: Research on Building Energy System Management System Based on New Power System under Carbon Peaking and Carbon Neutrality Goals
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Architecture is the key field to realize the carbon peaking and carbon neutrality goals, and it is also an important application scenario for the construction of new power system. This paper comprehensively examines the scientific management logic of building energy systems from the perspective of the impacts of carbon peaking and carbon neutrality goals and the construction of the new electricity system, providing practical approaches to promote the green and low-carbon transformation of buildings and expedite the realization of carbon peaking and carbon neutrality objectives. First, this study begins by exploring the role of the building sector in achieving "dual carbon" goals and developing the new electricity system, clarifying the development trends of building energy systems. Second, based on management systems and life cycle theories, a management framework for building energy systems under the "dual carbon" goals and the new electricity system is constructed. Finally, key management points for building energy systems in the context of these goals and the New electricity system are analyzed in detail based on this management framework. The research findings indicate that the deep integration of buildings and energy systems is an inevitable trend in the development of carbon peaking and carbon neutrality goals and the new electricity system. Under these goals, building energy systems based on the new electricity system will exhibit trends toward low-carbon or zero-carbon, flexibility, digitization or intelligence, and integration or platformization. Consequently, the management of building energy systems should emphasize collaborative efforts in three aspects: building itself, functional roles, and supporting elements.

Author Keywords: carbon peaking and carbon neutrality goals

articleTitle: Accelerated Testing and Data Analysis Method for Thyristor Irradiation Effect
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 8th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the extensive deployment of Ultra-High Voltage Direct Current (UHVDC) transmission systems, atmospheric neutron irradiation has emerged as a significant threat to the reliable operation of thyristors within the converter valves of converter stations. Therefore, it is essential to quantitatively investigate the effects of atmospheric neutron irradiation on thyristors in order to determine their failure rates. This paper presents a non-destructive experimental circuit that has been implemented in the thyristor irradiation experiments utilizing China Spallation Neutron Source (CSNS). In the nondestructive experimental circuit, the voltage stabilizing capacitor is not adopted and a protection resistor with resistance of tens of megaohms is utilized to limit the fault current when the single event burnout occurs. In the non-destructive experimental circuit, a voltage stabilizing capacitor is not employed; instead, a protection resistor with resistance in the range of tens of megaohms is utilized to limit fault current during single event burnout (SEB) occurrences.
